shin tu dpyod par byed/ /de yi ting 'dzin 'gro song rnams/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams tshig thos pa/ /thor tshugs can las zumangon du ste/ /slob mar 0bcas par nyan 'dod pa/ /gtsang gnas bdag po nyid kyang yin/ /thar zla blo gros mi zad dang / /nam mkha'i dbang po 'gro ba 'dzin/ /mthu chen spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /rnal 'byor shes pa gzungs kyi dbang / /lha yi cod pan rnal 'byor dbang / /gtsug na rin chen blo gros shing / /lag na rdo rje zhi ba'i blo/ /lag na rin chen blo chen dang / /'di dag rgyal sras gzhan dag kyang / /bye ba'i zhing rnams kun nas 'ongs/ /rdo rje'i 587snying po blo can la/ /de dag kun gyis rnam bltas nas/ /pad mo'i stan la 'khod pa'i rnams/ /rgyal ba'i sras la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo chen rab tu bshad par gyis/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams nyan par 'dod/ /'das pa dag dang ma 'ongs tshul/ /da ltar byung ba'i gang tshig kyang / /rgyu dang dpe yis rab gsal bar/ /khyod kyi zhal nas byung ba rnams/ /gdon mi 4za ba'i tshig 'di yang / /khyod kyis rgyal ba de zhal nas/ /thams cad ma lus thos pa ste/ /skyon med de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen/ /ting 'dzin dbang sgyur rgyal po yis/ /thams cad blo gros rnam bltas nas/ /rdo rje snying po 'jigs med kyis5/ /rnal 'byor can la tshig smras pa / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus par/ /smra bar sus kyang tsho6nus pa med/ /de yi byin rlabs 7ma gtogs par/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rgyal sras kyi/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal te/ /sangs rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa dag /nor bu rin chen sna tshogs khang / /dbang sgyur gnas bzang 'khod rnams la'ang / /ye shes dad pas smra bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rigs byed tshul yin te/ /58—54

nga ri1las 'di dag thams cad nyon/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi ye shes dge/ /rgyal po rnams la gtam 'di min/ /mi bdag mchog rnams 'das pa la'ang (nas/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs kyi gtam/ /stug dkyil phun sum tshogs rnams kyi/ /rnal 'byor can gyi rnal 'byor yul/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi phun sum tshogs/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi ye shes phra/ /rtog med rtog pa spangs pa ste/ /so so rang rig mkhas pa'i yul/ /brjod pa dang ni rnam par bral/ /de ni smra bar dad pa med / /bdag gis de yi mthu rinasathos pa/ /lha rdzas kyi ni ye shes dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi me tog gis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs pa ni/ /stug po'i dkyil du mnyam bzhag pas/ /thams cad phyogs las rnam ri4)grol zhing / /yod dang med pa'i phyogs spangs pa/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs dang bral/ /dbu ma'i lam ni dge ba ste/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba'i lha rdzas tshul/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'jug par byed/ /dbu ma'i lam po de nyid kyang / /mtha' bzhi rnam par spangs pa ste/ /rnam par rtog med dmigs 5med pa/ /stug na gnas pas shin tu mthong / /thub chen ne de nyid lam shes pa/ /bdag med ye shes mkhas rnams kyis/ /bla ma'i tshig 'di thos 75pa dang / /rnal 'byor can rnams thams cad kyang / /rkang pa gnyis la mnyam btud nas/ /rdo rje zhes la smras pa ni/ /rnal 'byor can rnams nyan par brtson/ /skom pa rnams ni chu tshol (85bzhin/ /khyod kyi zhal nas btung 'dod pa/ /tshig gi sbrang rtsi bung ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor dbang po yang dag gsungs/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams shin tu nyan/ /rnal 'byor can rnams rnal 'byor blo/ /ye shes dbang po 'phrul chen rnams/ /zhing gi bdag po rgyal chen rnams/ /rnal 'byor lam la rtog 9 byed pa/ /bde 58—55

gshegs bka' ni nyan par ro/ /khyod kyi zhal nas rnam byung ba/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dka' ba'i sgra/ /khong du chud byed mtshan bzang dang / /tshangs pa'i yang dag gshegs pa dang / /dbang po'i don grags khyad par du'o/ /sna tshogs thub pa de yi gsung / /sgra yi don la mkhas pa yi/ /de phyir bdag ni husmrar ma mos/ /brtag bya rtog pa rnam par spangs/ /bar snang ri mo ji bzhin dang / /grib ma stong la sogs pas spangs/ /de ste snang na rmad (gyidu rung / /de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa'i bka'/ /mkha' (gul bya rjes ji bzhin du/ /blta bar shin tu dkon pa bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa'i bka'/ /de ni bstan par mi nus so/ /sa rnams gsum du mkhas pa yis/ /dpe yis kun tu rab bstan gyis/ /dpe dang bral ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /thub pa'i zhal nas rnam par 'byunga'age/ /de yi tshig la dpe med de/ /rmi lam lta bur bdag la snang / /rab rib mgal pa bskor ba dang / /skra yi tshogs dang de ⑤bzhin 'dra//ji ltar sgyu ma'i grong khyer dang / /rlung ni shin tu blta dka' dang / /sgyu ma smig rgyu 96)'dra ba ste/ /rnam rtog gnyis po rab tu spangs/ /'on tam rnal 'byor sna tshogs pa/ /thub pa'i gsung ni de bzhin te/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor can dbus su/ /bshad par de phyir dad pa med/ /'di dag thams cad mkhas pa ste / /de bzhin nyid blo shes pa'i rnams/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul bsam yas pa/ /de phyir smra bar dad pa med/ /'on kyang brjod do thub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /de ring tshibadag las nyon cig rgyal sras rnams/ /sna tshogs tshig gi don ldan thub pa'i bka'/ /dpe med sems dang yid las rnam par 'das/ /ji ltar bung bas me tog ro 'thungs 98)shing / /lhag ma gzhan dag 'thung bar byed pa 58—56

bzhin / /snying khu hu)thub pa'i mchog rnams kyis 'thungs te/ /de yi 'thungs lhag bdag gis de ring bshad/ /de ni yid dang tshig gis kyang / /bstan por nus pa ma yin la/ /lha yi lha yi yul yin te/ /mkhas rnams dge ba 'phel bar byed/ /mi yi gzugs su byas nas su/ /sangs rgyas zhes ②ni mtshan ldan pa / /cod pan can dang gzhan la snang / /gzhal med khang gnas gzhan la yang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / /mtshan bzang50rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /sa la sna tshogs snang ba ni/ /mur 'dug 'dus pa'i dregs pa sel//dus rnams bzhi po thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dus dus la/ /stug na bzhugs pas dus sprul te/ /rnam par phye ba rab tu mdzad/ /bzang dus de bzhin gsum pa dang / /gnyis kyi pha rol dus ngan dang / /de dag du yang ci dgos pa/ /sa la lus can rnams kyis te/ /ldan pa de dag thams cad mdzad//stug po'i dkyil na bzhugs shing ste/ /stug po de ni dri med gnas/ /sbyor chen rnams kyi bde ba'i gzhi/ /ngan dang gnyis kyi pha rol mtshams/ /thub pa gzugs ni rnam bzung nas/ /dri med stug na rnal 'byor ldan/ /zla ba bzhin du 'gro la snang / /sna tshogs 'gro ba gang shes kyisañtsa)/ /sna tshogs gzugs su mdzes pa ni/ /gang la gang snang gang gis kyang / /ji ltar gang la de bde ba/ /de dag de la thams cad du/ /de phyir cha yis mig la gnas/ /shes can yul can thub pa ni/ /rnal 'byor mkhyen pa shes pas snang / /dbang po che gzugs gzhan dag dang / /'jug 'dod kyi dang de bzhin gzhan/ /ser skya yi yang gzugs su ste/ /thub pa la lar mkha' bzhugs pa/ /shes byed shes la yang dag snang / /sa nad sa nan da na la/ /sa nad gzhon nu me dag dang / /sgra 58—57

gcan mi ci ma 1bu ru/ /yig shwa ku dang zla ba'i rigs/ /thams cad sa yi rgyal po la/ /thams cad sa yang mchod pa ste/ /sku ni su su ci 'dod bzhin/ /la lar mur 'dug spyod sprul te/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyis mthong / /tshul gyi gtsug lag ston par yang / /ci bzhin rigs par rab ston cing / /rdo rje dngul dang gser dag dang / /zangs dang lcags kyi 'byung khungs dang / /ro nye zha nye mu tig dang / / pad ma rā ga 5an da rnyil/ / bee drurya nedang shel dag dang / /a sma gar bha mu sa ra/ /tshul dang brtags 8pa thams cad ldan//mkhan po bla ma kun 'gro 9dang / /gang gis lus can su su cir/ /sa la bde ba skye ba bzhin/ /de la de bde thams cad du/ /thub pa'i rnal 'byor rab las byung ༈ /lha yi bu mos mi spyod 7do/ /de bzhin dri za'i bud med kyis/ /'dod khams dbang po'i bud med dang / /de bzhin klu yi bud med kyis/ /mi ci lha min bu mo dang / /gnod sbyin bu mos de bzhin no/ /de ni 'dod pa'i yul las rgyal/ /gzugs can rnams kyi yul de bzhin/ /nam mkha' rnam shes mtha' yas dang / /cung zad med pa'ang de bzhin te/ /'du shes yod min ma yin gyi/ /gnas na rnam par rmongs pa med/ /kun tu 11la sogs 'di dag lam / /rnal 'byor can gyi 'ching ba'i dngos/ /ma zhi mi dge gzhan dag kyang //srog chags rnams kyi sa yod pa/ /lus can rnams kyi lus kyi yul/ /stug na gnas la stug na med/ /zhing de dri med bsod nams te/ /stug po snying po shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin thar pa thar shes la/ /zhing gi nang na zhing gi mchog /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing rab ste/ /stug po de ni yun du brtag /mnga' rnams bcu po de dag dang / /stobs dang mngon mkhyen ting nge 'dzin/ /yid 58—58

kyi rgyu las byung ba'i skus/ /sangs rgyas de na rnam par mdzes/ /sa rnams bcu po kun bsgoms te/ /rnam thar bden pa stong pa nyid/ /mtshan med 1smon pa med pa dang / /pha rol phyin drug de bzhin te/ /bsgom dang sbyin dang tshul khrims dang / /shes rab rnams kyis de sku 'thob/ /yan lag gzugs kun me tog gi/ /'dus ma byas pa sangs rgyas sku'o/ /rtog med rtog dang bral ba ste/ /bdag med yid dang dbang po rnams/ /shes rab dbang po'i sgor ldan zhing / /mtshan gyis kun nas shin tu bsags/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs kyis / /dkar po'i las rnams byas pas na/ /sangs rgyas sku yi gnas kyi mchog /stug po'i ris su 'thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha rdzas gnas/ /nyi zla rnam par spangs pa ste/ /rgyu skar skar phran snang ba dang / /zla ba dus dang ltad mo med/ /rnal 'byor can gyi 'od 'char dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od kyis kyang / /kun nas bzang po'i stug po de/ /nyi ma bzhin du kun nas snang / /dus kyi 'bri ba de na med/ /nad rnams gang yang yod pa min/ /'chi rga med pa'i gnas yin te/ /stug po de ni zhing gi mchog /thams cad gzugs ldan zhi ba'i gnas/ /dri med mthong ba'i tshogs can gyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing stug bsod nams te/ /lha rnams kun gyis smon par bya/ /rnal 'byor can rnams khyad par du/ /sa dang sa la gnas 4pa dag /sems tsam 5rang bzhin dngos po rnams/ /gang phyir rab tu bstan pas na/ /yid dang sems dang kun gzhi'i 'tshul/ /rang bzhin gsum po de bzhin te/ /chos la bdag med rang bzhin can / /gnas ni gzhan du 'gyur ba ste/ /lus ni shin tu gnas gyur pas/ /thub pa rnams ni der 'dong ste/ /rnal 'byor can gyi 58—59

gnas kyi mchog /stug po zhing rab dam par 6)ro/ /stug por 'jug pa zhes bya ba ste le'u gsum mos// //lus ni rdzas dgu'i rang bzhin can/ /'dus byas rdul phran tshogs yin te/ /yon tan tshogs kyis ④rnam sna tshogs/ /'byung dang 'byung gnas tshogs yin te / /khu chu khrag las kun 'byung ba/ /sngon ④med rnam par 'phel ba ste/ /steng gzugs 'og tu 'gro ba yin/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor thog ma med/ /las kyi rnam pa brgyas kyang g.yogs/ /dug gi shing gi (snyes bzhin du/ /dpa' dang rdul gyis 567de bzhin du/ /mun pas kyang ni gsos pa ste/ /lam rgyud dog par shin tu 'phyan ni/ /dus kyis bskul cing rab tu skye/ /yon tan las kyis 'da' ba ni/ /phyugs dang mi yi mngal skyes pas/ /klu dang yi dgas sha za dang / /'bar ba lha yi nang du yang / /skye 'am lha min 'jig rten nam/ /sngags 'chang rigs su de bzhin te/ /'on tam rnal 'byor can dbus su/ /bsam gtan zhig cing mngon skye ba/ /'khor lo 'khor rigs dam par yang /bar bar du ni skye bar 'gyur/ /skyes nas rig pa 'dzin pa ni/ /gang tshe dbang po 'phel ba na/ /su yi gang gi gang tshe las/ /lhan cig skyes pa rab byung zhing //lhan cig skyes pa'i las tshul gyis/ /lam dang lam du rab tu 'jug /brtag med rtog dang bral ba yi/ /gang tshe chos ni mngon rtogs na/ /thar pa rnams kyi thar gsum ste/ /yi ge yi ge med byas pa'o/ /'byung ba thams cad (8)rgyu yi tshogs / /de ni 'od snang mchog yin te/ /yang dag bla nas blar (95sbyangs pa/ /stug po'i dkyil na rnam par gnas/ /bye ba'i zhing dang mnyam lus kyis/ /58wa 60

sprul pas khyab par byas shing gnas/ /de ste de shes yod na ni/ /dog pa'i lam nas hu)'grol bar 'gyur/ /de lta'i skyes bu skyes pa ni(0/ /khyad par shes zhes (gyirnam par brjod/ /lha yi lha yis yang dag gsungs/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdun byas shing / /mngal gyi skye ba 'byung ba ni/ /byas pa yin no mi rnams kyi / /ma rig sred5gedang las skyes min/ /nyon mongs las las shin tu byung / /mtshan ma med pa mngon gyur cing / /mtshan ma med las rab 'das te/ /yi ge med pa de byung nas/ /spros pa thams cad rab bral zhing / /stug po'i dkyil du rab (getu 'gro/ /dmigs7las sems zhig 'gyur ba ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyi sgra rmongs pas/ /rtsed mo la sogs lha rdzas dang / /mtho ris bud med bsten nyarmongs kyis/ /gang tshe thub chen ma (8)'dug pa/ /de tshe sems ni 'byung ba ste/ /lam las bskyod ⑩ces bya ba yi/ /ting 'dzin 'dod pa'i khams skyes pa/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'gro ba na/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rab tu skye/ /sems can 'du shes medal )song na/ /ting nge 'dzin las bral bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' rnam shes mtha' yas kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin la dbang med 'gyur/ / rgyal ba /lhagang tshe thub dbang gyur/ /gnyis dang bral bas byang ba yi/ /sems ni mngon par mirwage'abyung ngo / /de bden de ni rnal 'byor te/ /bsam gtan pa yi bsam gtan yin/ /bsam gtan rtag tu bsam gtan bya / /de ste stug dkyil 'dod na'o/ /mngal gyi skye ba 'byung 3steb zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi'o(ste// //rnam brgyad rnam pa dgu yi sems/ /ma rig 'jig rten rgyu yin te/ /'di 58—61

ni sems dang sems 'byung mthu/ /gang gnas rnam pa sna tshogs pa'o/ /de yi mthus kyang 'jug pa ni/ /rnam shes rnams dang dbang po rnams/ /ma rig la sogs rnam pa 'di/ /rtsa ba'i sems ni brtan gnas pa/ /yan lag bcu gnyis thams cad dang / /'byung ba rnams dang 'byung gnas dang / /yul dang dbang po 'jig rten dang / /skad cig 'jig pa'i rgyu yin no/ /thub pa lha yi lhas 1gsungs pa/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu spangs pa sten/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mthar thug gi/ /'gro ba dbang por bcas pa 'di/ /'jig rten btsal (dbas ma bskyed de/ /bdag nyid rdza ma bzhin 'jig pa/ / nang dang 4phyi dag rtag 5par te/ /'gro ba gnas dang g.yo ba dag /lha yi lha yi yul yin te/ /sa la sus kyang mi snyomathong ba/ /mur 'dug grags pa gzhan dag ste/ /thub grags mtshan ma can gyis so/ /phan tshun bcings pas bcings pa ni/ /srid pa sna tshogs rnam pas te/ /rnam shes myur du 'gro bas na/ /sems kyi rnam par mi rtogs so/ /lo stong mtha' ru thug pa yi/ /mchod sbyin rnams kyis tshangs pa'i thabs/ /thob nas slar du ldog pa ni/ /sa ma ya ru rigs sems pa/ /'dod sbyor bkag srog 'bras bu dang / /gang yang zla ba'i 'bras bu dang / /mer gzhug 7pa yi 'bras bu dang / /gang gzhan mchod sbyin 'bras bu dang / /phyugs bcing ba 8yi 'bras bu yang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas ldog go/ /chos gsum can gyi 'gro ba dag /ci nyes mi rig thor tshugs can/ /yon tan gsum gyi 'bru 'brel ba/ /chu skyes bzhin du snying po med/ /'di yis thar pa mi rnyed pa/ /stug po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ /de ni rnal 'byor gyis 'thob ste/ /stug po rnal 'byor rig pa'i gnas/ /de bas tshul gcig tshangs 58—62

pa'i bdag /rnal 'byor can rnams 'jug brtson par/ /'di la bdag gnyen gang dag kyang / /skye zhing 'chi ba yod med de/ /mi chod gzhig tu med pa ni/ /lus can kun gyi rnam par shes/ /bag chags kyis ni mi gos pa/ /sngon med dus nas byung bas so/ /yid kyi gnas ngan len bsags pa'i/ /spros pas kyang ngo cir mi 'jug /ji ltar lha 1rdzas chu skyes dang / /nam mkha' la yang phyag dar dang / /sprin gyi dri mas nyi zla la/ /de bzhin mi gos rnal 'byor can/ /ma bshol rab tu brtson par gyis/ /thams cad sangs rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /rnal 'byor bde gshegs lha yi rdzas/ /rnal 'byor can gyi tshul skyed napa/ /tshul khrims can gyi tshul 'thungs te/ /ye shes can gyis shes 'thungs shing / /mchog gi ye shes 'thungs nas kyang / /'khor ba las ni 'da' bar gyis/ /'di la khams rnams gang yang med/ /phung po lnga dang rnam shes kyang / /ming dang gzugs dag ri rgyur byas shing / /lus can rnams kyi yid kyang skye / /ji ltar me ni shing dbang gis/ /'bar te 55'bar bar rtog pa med/ /de bzhin phung po shing rta stong / /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /ri dgas srid 56chodang dri za yi/ /gnas dang sgra 7tshogs snang ba ru/ /ri dgas bus pa 8ril sogs mthong / /yang dag ma yin ltas bslad pas/ /de bzhin yul las byung ba'i sems / /khab long lta bur 'khor ba ste/ /gang yang 'di la dngos med pa/ /'byung ba rnams dang 'byung ba yi9/ /g.yo ba dro ba gsher 1 sra bar/ /bus pa rnams ni rtag tu rtog /'byung ba sems kyi tshogs las na11/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /ji tsam ma zhig lus yod dang / /ji tsam du ni blo 'byung ba / /de bar rnal 'byor ye shes la/ /ma gshol 12bsam gtan rab tu gyis/ /58—63

thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /'byung ba gsum kun rab tu ltos/ /smig rgyu chu zla lta bu na0)/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /ji bzhin dri za'i gong khyer na / /'gro ba'i spyod pa rnam par snang / /de bzhin lus la phung po'i spyod/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /rmi lam dag na 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /ji ltar rmi lam rmi bas mthong / /de bzhin phung po'i gnas yin na/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /sa 'di sa la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /'dus pa rdul gyi phung po yin / /'di sems sems byung tshogs yin par/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams kun ltos na shig /'byung ba chen po bzhi po rnams/ /phan tshun kun nas 'dus pa ste / /gdeg pa la sogs ldan pa yin/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /'di ni rlung dang mkhris pas myos/ /ro bslab ①lta bur gnas pa ste/ /byed pa gang yang 37yod pa min she/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /dbu ba'i gong bu lta bu kun/ /'gro ba gnas shing g.yo ba'i rnams/ /smig rgyu 'dra ba'i 'du shes su/ /rdza la yisogs pa shin tu rtogs/ /tshor ba chu bur lta bu ste/ /bde dang mi bder rtog dzopa yin/ /chu shing 'dra ba'i 'du byed rnams/ /zhig pa grugs pa snying po med/ /rnam par shes pa 90sgyu ma 'dra/ /de yi dngos la gnas pa med/ /rtswa shing gnas pa ji bzhin te99)/ /ci phyir rnal 'byor 'jug mi bya/ /'di ni rmi lam rnam myos 'di/ /'di ni sgyu ma bus pa 'drid/ /'di dag thams cad smig rgyu 1 tshoste/ /de bzhin dri za'i grong khyer ro/ /gang rgyan hu7'di dag snang ba yi/ /khams gsum 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de 32kun blo yis rtogs bya ba/ /'jigs med rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /nyes pa'i rgyu72ni rtswa snyadang bcas/ /ye shes me yis rab bsregs na/ /lha rdzas bde ba yod par 'gro/ /rnal 'byor 58—64

can gnas stug por yang / /'jigs med 'di ni mtshan ma med/ /mtshan ma bcings pa'i ngo bo can/ /mtshan ma med pa rtag tu bde/ /mtshan ma sems kyi spyod yul lo/ /sems kyi spyod yul bden pa min/ /bden pa blo gros spyod yul te / /sems ni shes rab spyod yul te/ /mtshan mar gnas pa med pa'o/ /kye ma mtshan ma 'di kun yin/ /gnas gsum tshangs par bsgrags pa ste/ /mtshan ma ming dang yul rnams dang / /sgra la sogs pa kun brjod pa'o/ /dbang po kun gyi yul rnams ni/ /lus can rnams kyi 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /'ching bar bya dang 'ching dang rgyu/ /gang 'grol gang gis 'grol ba dang / /thar dang thar pa'i bde ba dang / /mthong ba'i chos la gnas pa dang / /bdag med pa ru shes nyid kyang / /'dod chags bcom par gyur pa na'o/ /de nas mi bdag rin chen gtsug /blo chen byang chub hu)sems dpa' yis/ /rnal 'byor can kun dbang la smras/ /rdo rje'i snying po 'jigs med la/ /bye (geba'i zhing rnams thams cad la/ /rgyal sras khyod ni brtson pa ste/ /rgyal ba rnams la khyod ②tshad de / /rnal 'byor can la nye bar gnas/ /rnal 'byor the tshom bcad ④pa ste/ /dpe rnams grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /brtag bya yan lag thams cad dag /lus can rnams kyi lus skyes pa/ /tshul ni sgra yis brjod par mdzad/ /tshig /zhesatu brjod par cir mi bgyi/ /gnad dang zung gis yirnam/ par mdzod(ge/ /mi zin pa yi (gyirgyu rnams dang / /bgab zungs nor (9nogyis gzhom par gyis4 )/ /phung po'i rgyu rnams bsal she1bar mdzod/ /yang dag 'gyur ba med pa dang / /dge ba yis kyang mkhas pas so/ /ring po mi thogs thar pa 'thobatshon/ /phung po'i rgyu rnams bsregs snyenas su/ /chos min chos kyi tshe 'byung ste/ /'di dang gzhan 58—65

du'ang 'thob par 'gyur/ /shes pas sdug bsngal rnams las 'grol/ /sred pa yis ni rtag tu bcings/ /mi shes las dang srid tsho1pa yis/ /lus can rgya cher shin tu byas/ /gzugs dang snang ba yid byed dang / /rnam shes yul la mngon gyur pas/ /myur phyir khong du mi chud pa/ /spyod yul du ni sems rgyu ba'o/ /yid sngon 'gro ba chos rnams te/ /lus can kun gyi de bzhin no/ /yid 'gro yid ni gces pa dag /yid du 'ong bas cir mi bshad/ /gang dang gang gi rdzas kyis su/ /mi rnams stug por 'grub pa yi/ /des ni de yi na)dngos 'gyur ba / /sna tshogs gzugs kyi nor bu bzhin/ /ji ltar nor bu sna tshogs gzugs/ /tshon dang 'byor na rnam par mdzes/ /rnal 'byor can dbus khyod de bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs gzugs sna tshogs kyis/ /dbang sgyur pho brang dge ba na/ /thams cad dag na snang ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnamadun du byas/ /mya ngan 'da' dang mya ngan 'das/ /stug po mthar mchog ye shes te/ /chos kyi dbyings dang rdzu 'phrul yang / /stug de rnal 'byor can gyi gnas/ /de ni mtshon gyis mi chod de / /de ni mes kyang mi tshig pa/ /mi chod pa dang mi phyed (5pa / /de ni yul gnas rtag pa'o/ /de ni chus kyang mi gsher te/ /rlung gis kyang ni mi skam mo/ /de ni rdza ltar 'jig pa dang / /nan tan bya rjes 'byung ba min / /rtag pa brtan pa mi 'jig pa/ /skye can kun gyi rnam par shes/ /rgyu yis sun dbyung ma yin pa/ /'dra dang mi 'dra rnams kyis te / /dam bcas yan lag rnams kyi yang / /mtha' ma thug pa med par 'gyur/ /dam bcas pa yi dam bca' dang / /rgyu yi khyad par rgyu dag ste/ /de bas de la rgal du med/ /rtog pa can gyi spyod yul min/ /rnam par shes pa gzhan gyur na/ /de ni stug 58—66

po sems spangs pa'o/ /rtog can rnams kyi yul ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang stug /ma skyes sngon dang tha ma med/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i stobs las byung / /rgyu med pa dang las skyes min/ /dbang po chen pos byas pa'ang min / /gzugs med gzugs dang 'dod pa las/ /yang dag 'das te gnas pa yin/ /'dod pa'i khams las 'das nas su/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'du shes med/ /mun pa'i rgyu las rab 'das nas/ /stug po'i zhing ni rnam par mdzes/ /phyogs 'di mkha' las grub pa ste/ /rgyu can rnams kyi spyod yul min / /yod dang med pa'i phyogs dang bral/ /gcig dang gzhan pa spangs pa'o / /gces pa dang ni rang bzhin min/ /'dod rgyal dang yang dbang po min / /khyu mchog gi yang phyogs ma yin/ /de bzhin rig 1can gsum gyi yang / /rdul gyi rkyen las byung ma yin/ /sgra rnams kyis kyang brjod du med/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bskyed pa min/ /'dod rgyal gyis kyang mi rnyed do/ /ma rig las dang srid pas min/ /mi shes las kyang smos pa min/ /khur khyer (5khur gyi yul yin te/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul/ /lha rdzas de bzhin gshegs kyis mkhyen/ /sa bcu dag tu rnam par sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor can gyi sna tshogs yul/ /don gyi dam pa ston pa'o/ /las ci las min gang zhes te/ /byis pa rnams ni myos par gyur / /las dang las min bshad pa nas/ /rnal 'byor can rnams bder gyur pa / /sna tshogs snang ba rang sems te/ /lus can rnams kyi bdag nyid gnyis/ /phyi dang nang dang thams cad du/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa lta bur gnas/ /sems kyis sems ni mthong yin yang / /khong du mi chud bus pa rnams/ /kha gnyis sems de lus can gyi/ /yin kyang shes par ma gyur pa/ /dzodag gi byed 50—67

pa'ang de bzhin byed/ /yul lta bur yang rab tu snang / /rdza ma la sogs gzugs su gnas/ /rdza la sogs pa'ang yod pa min/ /'di yi don la thub pa dag /rnal 'byor nyam chung rnam par myos/ /rnal 'byor de yang mi rtogs pa/ /bdag gi rnam rtog lam gnas pas/ /sems 'di gnyis ku'i bdag nyid de/ /me long zla ba bzhin du gnas/ /ji ltar rab rib rab rib can/ /skra tshogs ltos shig ltos lho)shig kye'on)/ /phan tshun dag tu ston mod kyi/ /bdag nyes dbang po zhan byung gi/ /'di na du gang yang skra ④tshogs med/ /rgyan dang nor bu dag kyang ngo / /yod dang med pa'i dngos po ltar/ /dbang po'i nyes ①pas mthong ba yin/ /de bzhin rtog can dbang gis 'di/ /bdag gi blo ni ji dultar gnas / /tshangs la sogs pa'i gnas thug (7༄par/ /rtog pa med pas rab tu 'dzin / /gang 'di mang po snang ba dag /sna tshogs tshangs la sogs pa'i mtshan / /sna tshogs thams cad bdag gi sems/ /rdza la ⑧sogs pa'i yon tan mtshan / /nang du gyur pa'i gzugs rnams dang / /mtho ris gnas pa'i gnas rnams dang / /gang 'di phyi nang bya ba rnams/ /thams cad sems las byung ba'o / /rgyan stug rnal 'byor gang yin pa/ /de ni gud na yod pa min/ /rnal 'byor can gyi bsod nams kyis/ /zhugs pa 'di la 67bslab par gyisatshu/ /dbang sgyur lha rdzas gnas dag dang / /yang na gzugs can rnams gnas dang / /'du shes med pa'i gnas su 'am/ /'og ma yin pa'i gnas su yang / /cung zad med dang rnam shes dang / /'du shes yod pa ma yin dang / /sna tshogs kyi ni gnas dag tu/ /'dod chags kyi ni phyogs bshig na/ /khyod ni myur du der gnas pa/ /stug po rnal 'byor can gnas su/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdun 58—68

byas te/ /stug po der ni 'gro bar gyis/ /rnal 'byor de la spyad par gyis/ /bdag gi gnyen gyis ci zhig bya/ /bdag gi gnyen ni rtag tu 'ching / /'khor ba'i lam rgyud rgyu yang yin/ /dbang po rnams ni g.yo ba ste/ /bud med rnams la'ang blo 'khrul pas/ /khu chu khrag mnam mi zhim pa'i/ /'ji bar srin bu skyes gyur pa/ /dgu 'am bcu zhig pa dang yang / /khu chu smin nas mngon par skye/ /dbang po rnams kyis kun yog pa/ /srin bu g.yo ba ji bzhin te/ /rim pa de yi tshul gyis na/ /ji srid sems can gnas bar du'o/ /lus can rnams kyi skye la ltos/ /tshe tsher de dag byung ba ste/ /pha dang ma ni stong dag dang / /bu dang chung ma brgya dag kyang / /thams cad gnas su rnyed pa ni/ /lus can skye la gnas pa'o/ /rmi lam dag na bu med pa'i/ /mo gsham nyu)bu 'byung ji bzhin du/ /bu rnyed pa yi〈snyedaga' ba dang / /rmi lam rmi tshe de nyid ldan/ /de ni shir gyur de nas de/ /rmi lam shes nas sad pa dang / /rmi lam gyi ni bu shi med/ /gang yang skye ba yod pa min/ /chu bo rab tshal bu dang ni/ /grong khyer dag dang ri rnams dang / /grong dang tshong 'dus phyugs slas (༷dang / /dka' thub tshal bu'i gnas rnams dang / /'gro ba dag gis rgyas pa'i yul/ /zhing dang ba lang lug gis gang / /'jig rten gyi ni longs spyod kyang / /de dang 'di dang gzhan du'ang snang / /ji ltar 'jig rten 'dir rgyug shu rapa/ /rmi lam rgyug pa de bzhin te / /gdeg dang bskum la sogs pa yang / /de dang 'dir yang snang ba yin/ /mkhas pas rmi lam gang mthong ba/ /skye ba med cing 'chi (gemed par/ /slar sad nas su sems pa ni/ /bu mo mkhas pa dag yin no/ /ji ltar ri dang de'u rnams kyi/ /grib ma kun du snang ba bzhin/ /de ltar 'jig rten rmi lam yang / /58—69

mkhas pa rnams ni de bzhin bsam/ /ji ltar skyes bu nyal ba zhig /bud med lhan cig rtse dga' rmi/ /sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba dang / /lha rab btsun mo mnyam pa dang / /gzhan yang sna tshogs dngos pos te/ /sad nas rnam par sems pa ni/ /ci zhig bden nam rmi lam yin/ /rmi lam bud med lhan cig tu / /rtses nas phyir ni bdag sad de/ /'di brdzun 1)bus pa slu ba yin/ /de bzhin bdag gi gnyen pa kun/ /rgyal srid stobs kyang de bzhin no/ /dmag (5ripa gyos po bu dag dang / /ma dang phu nu pha ri dag kyang / /rmi lam lta bur rig bya ste / /rnal 'byor sbyar bar jir mi bya/ /dka' thub tshal dang zhing rnams dang //ri dang ri yi 0sman gshong dang / /'o ma 'byung dang mā 5skul ya/ /lhun po byin dang lhodabang chen dang / /gangs 7kyi ri dang kai lā sa na/ /char 'bab la yang gang gnas dang / / 'dzam bu 9'bras bu'i khu ba dang / /gang dag bdud rtsi za ba dang / /phan du kum bal 1 par ya tra/ /ko bi dar na gang 'khod dang / /ri rab nang na gang gnas dang / /dpag bsam shing la gang 17gnas 32dang / /rang rgyal rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang / /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / /thams cad kyi ni rnal 'byor 'di/ /gang 'byung 'byung ba rnams kyi ste/ /pad mo'i gnas su brten 1 bcas te/ / skyil mo krung 1 du mnyam bzhag 15cing / /rtag tu rnal 'byor sbyang 17bar gyis/ /'dod dang bde las rnam par dben/ /dbang po dbang po'i don gyi rnams/ /thams cad las kyang phyir bzlog cing / /lcags kyus 7glang po ji bzhin du/ /sems ni mnyam par bzhag 18par gyis/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das bsam gtan/ /gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge / /'dod dang dga' ba dben la sogs/ /yang na thams cad bsgrags pa 50—70

dang / /khyad par du yang gzugs med dang / /'du shes med pa'i bsam gtan rnams/ /nam mkha' rnam shes mtha' yas dang / /'du shes yod min med min rnams/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba'i dbyibs/ /pad mo dang ni 'od 'dra zhing / /nam mkha' (1 ri mo me 'dra bar/ /rnal 'byor zhugs pas rab tu mthong / /'di dag thams cad spangs nas su/ /snang ba med par rab tu gnas / /gang tshe mtshan med rnal 'byor can/ /rnam par mi rtog 5)chags med na / /sangs rgyas bye ba rnams kyang mthong / /zhing dang zhing na mnyam bzhag ( ripa / /de dag phyag gis casadabang bskur bar/ /de yi spyi bor dbang bskur te/ /sangs rgyas sa la zhugs pa dang / /sna tshogs gzugs ni rab tu 'byung / /sna tshogs tshul gyi 5dngos thob nas/ /kun mkhyen thams cad rig par 'gyur/ /stobs dang mngon shes dbang yang 'thob/ /gzungs dang thams cad ting nge 'dzin / /thams cad kyi ni 'byung gnas 'gyur/ /thub pa rnal 'byor skyed pa'i yang (6)/ /gzugs ni rdul du rnam gzhigs 7shing / /mchog rdul yan chad nyin dben phyir/ /yod las med par 'gyur ba ste/ /bong bus na ba lang rwa mthong bzhin / /cha shas 9med phyir cha shas 1 can/ /phung po las ni phung can med/ /de bas las kyi 'bras gyur pa/ /'di ni sgyu ma'i bus byas bzhin/ /'di na 1 las med 'bras bu med/ /las kyi sgrub pa'ang yod pa min/ /'jig rten byed pas ma byas te/ /byed pa byed pa ma yin no/ /byed la byed pa yod na ni/ /'di rnams thug pa med par 'gyur/ /thug med byas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /thub pa dri ma can du gyur/ /de ste lam rgyud sna tshogs rnams/ /chu dang nam mkha' sa gnas pa'i/ /lus can lus la kun gnas te/ /skye ba bzang po gnas su 58—71

ste / /ris su 'gro ba yod pas na/ /ji ltar 'dod par lus can 'gro/ /dbang po so so bya ba yang / /ji ltar 'dod par yul 'dzin te/ /'di ni rnam rtog rnam 'gyur ba/ /zho mar ji ltar 'o ma las/ /de bzhin skye dang gnas dang 'jig /las kyis byas par 'gyur sems na/ /rmi lam dri za sgyu ma sprin/ /brag ca hu)dang ni glog ②'dra ba/ /smig rgyu ①ri dgas srid pa ltar/ /dngos po rnam ④bsgoms rnal 'byor can/ /thogasem med nas bsags pa yi/ /mi⑥yi rnam spros bag chags kyis/ /sna tshogs gnas ngan len pa dang / /sna tshogs rtog pas las su brtags/ /dbang po sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /yul rnams rmi lam 'dra ba ste/ /byed dang las dang bya ba yang / /rnal 'byor sgrub pas mi brtag go / /rtog pa nyams pa'i rtog pa can/ /rnam myos shes pa nyam tso)chung bas/ /byed par rab tu rtog pa ni/ /bya bas 'gro bar byas par te/ /'jig rten gces pas byas ma yin/ /2rdul gyi rkyen las byung ba'ang min/ /rgyu med pas kyang byas ma yin/ /ngo bo nyid kyis byung ba'ang min/ /rdo rje lcags dang khab long dang / /rin chen phreng〈nyeb rgyanarwa )rnams kyis/ /ji lta bu yi nyarmelas shig byas / /nor bu gser du ming btags rtepas/ /bya dang ri dgas khra bo dang / /tsher ma rnams kyi rno dngos dang / /'gro ba sna tshogs ngo mtshar ba/ /rnam rtog las las ma skyes so/ /las kyi7/gang las ma yin zhes/ /rtog can bden la myos pa ni/ /bden pa'i dngos por mi shes pa/ /'di ni rnam rtog las min du / /'o ma'i nang na yod pa'i dug3ste /rjes su mi nyebade rnam par 'gyur/ /rnam par rtog pa'ang thams cad du/ /de bzhin dngos po rnams la 'jug /dngos po skye ba ma yin te/ /dngos po rnam par 'jig pa'ang med/ /rnam rtog 58—72

sna tshogs de dag ni/ /rtog pa can gyis mi rig go/ /'gro ba'i ris kyi dngos po dag /rnal 'byor spyod pas rnam par gzhig /sbyar zhing rnal 'byor de la zhugs/ /las dang las min ma sems par/ /ris su 'gro ba'i dngos po yis / /zla ba nyi ma rnam mdzes pa/ /rlung gis shin tu bskyod nas kyang / /mkha' la rten 6)pa med par 'gro/ /shin tu phra zhing shes dka'i las/ /stug por gnas par rab tu mthong / /las de ci zhig yod par 'gyur/ /zhugs brtson rnal 'byor can dag la/ /ji ltar me ni shing gi ri/ /thal ②bar byed pa skad cig tu/ /rnal 'byor can gyi thams cad las/ /ye shes mes tshig skad cig tu/ /las dang bag chags lhan cig tu/ /mang po'i dus nas bsags pa dag /rnal 'byor ye shes bag chags kyis/ /thams cad zhig byed skad cig tu / /ji ltar sgron mas mun pa'i tshogs/ /skad cig tu ni bsal ⑦byed pa/ /ye shes sgron mas thub pa de/ /mi shes rnam par sel bar bya/ /rgyan stug po theg pa chen po'i mdo las bdag gi las kyi bya ba spyad pa zhes bya ba ste/ le'u lnga pa'o// //(snyebam po gsum pa/ 'jim pa rtswa smig 6)thag pa las/ /ji ltar gnas pa'i khyim gyi rnams/ /phan tshun kun nas 'dus 'byor cing / /sa yi dbus na snang ba ni/ /re re la yang khyim med de/ /rdzas dang dngos la rnam brtags na/ /rdzas kyi rnam pa 'dus pa la/ /khyim zhes gdags9)shing brjod pa ste/ /sor mo phan tshun kun 'dus na/ /ji ltar lag pa'i phug ron du(kye/ /lag pa gnyis ni bsdus las 'gyur/ /tha dad pa las mi 'byung ngo / /g.yul dang shing rta 58—73

bsnyems bral khang 1/ /grong khyer nags tshal de bzhin te/ /ri dang sprin dang dba' rlabs kyang / /brag ca naglog dang 'dra ba'o/ /smig sgyu chu zla sgyu 'dra ba/ /snam bu rdza sogs grags pa ste/ /mkhas la dngos po thams cad kyang / /rmi lam 'dra bar kun tu snang / /de bzhin lus khyim sna tshogs pa/ /bus pa'i lam rgyud dog pa na/ /khams kyis ri bzhin gyur pa ste/ /khyim ltar rtag tu mi brtan la/ /'byung ba med cing 'jig pa med/ /bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /rtag dang chad las rnam par grol/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa yongs su spangs/ /ji ltar dri za'i grong khyer ni/ /mdog tu zad kyang grong ltar snang / /de bzhin rang rtog rnam brtags pa'i/ /dngos po rnams kyang rab tu 'byung / /chos rnams smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /yod med rnam bral dge ba yin/ /rmi lam sprin ltar snang ba ste/ /rtsig ngos ri mo'i 4phug lta bu'o/ /zha bo long ba 'dra ba ni/ /dngos kun gcig gis gcig rgyu ba/ /rang bzhin rtogs par mi rung ste/ /rnal 'byor can gyis yang dag mthong / /rdul phran rnam par gzhigs pa dang / /rdul gyi dngos po mi gnas te/ /rang bzhin kun gyi mchog yin pas/ /rdul phran mchog ces de phyir brjod/ /de phyir blo ni phyir ldog ste/ /sgra la sogs pa'i yon tan spangs/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /de tshe ngal bso'i 5yid du 'gyur/ /ngal bso'i kyiyid ldan rnal 'byor can/ /bcings pa kun las grol bas na/ /'di dang pha bir mi skye ste/ /bsam gtan tshul la mos pa rnams / /sna tshogs rin chen snying po yi/ /gnas na dbang can de dag rtse/ /yon tan dbang phyug 7nyes pa med/ /rig 'dzin bud med mang po dang / /thub pa rnams kyis rab mchod cing / /rmi lam bzhin du gnas pa yin/ /'di 51—74

na gnas kyang tshangs pa dang / /thub dang thub pa'i bu rnams dang / /rig 'dzin tshogs kyis de bzhin te/ /spyi gtsug blta 91)bar mi nus so/ /'di ni nathub pa'i rnal 'byor yul/ /de bas bsam gtan brtson par gyis/ /'di ni kun gyi yul ma yin/ /de phyir grogs po bstan par gyis/ /brtan pa sa rnams sna tshogs dang / /'od can rnams kyi gnas su yang / /'dod chags phyogs dang bcas pa dang / /gti mug zhe sdang de bzhin du/ /bcom ste stug po tsho norab yangs pa/ /yid bzhin zhi ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /de ni 'chi bdag yul ma yin//rnam shes spyod yul de bzhin min/ /mtshan ma med pa'i gnas yin te/ /rtog pas de bsgrub ma yin no/ /'di ni lha rdzas gnas yin te/ /thub pa rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /de bas zhing mchog de 'dod na/ /thub pas bsam gtan de la gyis / /'dod chags zhe sdang rnam bcom ste/ /nga med nga yi 'gro med du/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mi bsam par/ /bsam gtan mchog la bsgom par gyis/ /phan tshun yul la 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /gnyis kyi blo ni rab tu 'byung / /yod med rtog pas de bzhin du/ /rnam shes rnams la kun gzhi'o/ /bud med ro smad shas rgyas shing / /skra bzang mig kyang mdzes pa dang / /sna legs 'phral 4 ba'i dbyibs sdug la/ /smin ma stug gcing blta mdzes pa/ /ji ltar la la der chags pa'i/ /yid kyis rnam par myos pa'i sems/ /lta zhing rnam par rtog pa'i tshe/ /mkhas min de la shin tu myos/ /'gro 'dug 'greng yang de bzhin te//snom za 56tshoganyid kyis log pa na'ang / /'dod can gzhan du mi sems te/ /'dod pa can mo yid la byed/ /de bzhin khyod blo rnyog pa can/ /rnam pa kun tu yid la gnas/ /rdzab yul rnyog dang ldan pa yi/ /bcings pa'i dbang du ma 58—75

'gro shig1 /ji ltar la la rtog pa can/ /blo yi spyod yul rnam 'khrul ba/ /ma he dag dang ba 2glang dang / /glang po dag dang bse rnams dang / /rang ga kṛtta riras ra dang / /sha ra ba ④dang su ra dang / /smyan (snyedang g.yag kyang de bzhin te/ /mgo dkar rna 6)dang khyu mchog gi/ /ru chen rnam par mthong ba dang / /'di bden gzhan du mi 'gyur zhes/ /seng stag bong bu sogs pa yi/ /rwa rnams la ni med ces te/ /yod dang med pa'i lta ba yang / /mi mkhas rnams la rab tu 'byung / /de ltar gzhan gyi rwa mthong zhing / /bong bu'i med ces rnam rtog 'byung / /ji ⑨ste gzhan gyis rinasam mthong na/ /bong ru po)med snyam de mi 'byung / /log par dmigs pa'i rgyu yi hu )phyir/ /'di na med ces rtog pa 'byung / /de la dmigs pa med pas kyang / /gdon mi za bar med la rten⑩/ /rnyog can nga rgyal rtog yul lahurte/ /blo gros spyod yul ma rtog 1)cig /ba lang ba man /rim he rnams/ /rtog pas brtags pa ji bzhin te/ /de ltar khyod kyis sems spyod dang / /phung po skye mched spyod yul dag /mngon sum tshad ma dag gis sam1lta/ /shes rab kyis kyang rnam par ltos/ /rnam grol mtho ris 'gro ba 'am / /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du'ang 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su tshangs par ram/ /mtshe ma rab dang gnas dben dang / /rin chen sna tshogs gnas su yang / /dbang sgyur rnam par mdzes par 'gyur/ / 'od chung 16rgyas pa dag tu 'am/ /'dod khams bdag po dbang can nam/ /nyi zla bdag bdag gnas su 'am/ /gzhan yang 'od 'bar gzar 12yang rung / /sum cu nyi rtsa gsum rgyal chen dang / /'phrul la dga' ba'i gnas su yang / /tshangs gnas bcu 3)dang ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor can ni 2 starnam par mdzes/ /gya nom snang dang shin tu 58—76

mthong / /'dod med mi dros7)de bzhin te/ /'og min gnas kyi lha rdzas na/ /'og min shin tu rnam par mdzes/ /cung zad med mkha' rnam shes dang / /'du shes yod med ma yin dang / /de bzhin 'phrul gyi bde can dang / /zhing bzang gzhan du de bzhin te/ /mkha' la 'gro dang spobs pa bzhin/ /'khor lo 'khor ba'i rigs su gnas/ /grol ba rnams kyi grol yul la(khu/ /su gnas de dag rnal 'byor can/ /'dod chags stobs las sngon rgyal ba/ /de dag bzang po'i sa la gnas/ /'di lta'i rnal 'byor ldan pas na(khu/ /rnal 'byor la (nani thub par rtse/ /rdza ma 'jig pa'i lagyo mo yi/ /ji ltar rgyur yang 'gyur ba dang / /skad cig 'jig la skad cig ste/ /mi rtag nyid kyang rtag pa yi/ /sa bon ji bzhin myu gu la/ /rgyu rnams de dag 'dra ba yin/ /myu gu gzhan min sa bon las/ /sa bon nyid kyang myu gu min/ /sa snar rnams las rdza snar 'byung / /tshos nas skyodamar rur mngon par 'byung / /gnag dang snar dang 'dres pa dang / /gro bo dmar po dag kyang skyepe/ /'dam bu las ni sgog par 'gyur/ /rwa las lan tshwar nide bzhin te/ /mi gtsang sbrang bu dag las kyang / /srin bur 'gyur gzhan mi 'dra mang / /rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /sa rnams gang na'ang yod pa min/ /gyur pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung / /rdul phran gang dag rgyur 'gyur ni/ /dngos po 'jig pa med par te/ /rnam par rtog la mi rtog cing / /rgyu yi bdag dang nang gi bdag /bdag gi mchog kyang med pa ste/ /bdag dang dbang po yid dang don/ /'dus pa'i rgyu ni ma yin te/ /phrad las 'byung dang rnam shes dang / /rkyen 6)rnams yod pa ma yin no/ /shes can shes pas yul rnams la/ /mkhas pa'i stobs dang ldan pas ni/ /sde dpung stobs 58—77

dang bzhon bcas pa'i/ /nyon mongs bdud rnams gdul bar bya/ /sred pa 'jig rten dma' bar byed/ /sbrang rtsis bad kun mang po bzhin/ /sred pa bcom zhing thub pa'i rnams/ /rnam pa ga1mang las rnam par grol/ /sred pas rnam par dkrugs pa na / /'khor las rnam par mi 'grol te/ /sred dang rnam bral 'thar bar 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sbyar bar gyis/ /yun ring yod pa'i bag chags ni/ /sprul gdug khros pa ji bzhin yang / /'di dang pha bir 'drid pa ni/ /'khor ba'i lam rgyud dog par ro/ /'phags pa rgyan stug po las rnal 'byor rnam par phye ba'i spyod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug go // //sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rnam phye dang / /bdag ldan de yi byin gyis brlabs5 / /rgyal ba dag dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /bye ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa dang / /khams gsum gnas pa thams cad dang / /sa gnas rnal 'byor ldan pa dang / /bde yod zhing dang stug po 6ste/ /rnal 'byor can gyi zhing mchog dang / /sangs rgyas pad mo'i dbus bzhugs pa/ /rdul phran bzhin bzhugs bdag gis mthong / /rnal 'byor de las bdag langs nas/ /sa la rgyal ba de dag ni/ /stug po'i zhing na bdag bzhugs shing / /rgyal sras thabs cig bzhugs pa dag /me tog a ta si 'dra ba'i/ /mkha' la zla 'dra bzhin bzhugs mthong / /mthe bo'i tshigs dang rab 'dra ba/ /sa rnams dge la rab sbyor ba'i/ /rnam grol snying po bdag gis mthong / /'di na bu khyod su zhig ces / /snying po de ltar sems gyur te/ /thub pa 'di ni gcig cig snyam/ /de tshe sku ru zhugs par gyur/ /'gro ba rnams kyang skur zhugs 7nas/ /thub pa'i 9kyi58—78

pad mo'i snying po yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi longs spyod dang / /khams gsum kun na tsho1)gnas par yang / /gang tshe mthong ba de dus na/ /kye ma mtshar ches (5ribasam pa dang / /de tshe thub pa lha yi lhas/ /rnal 'byor yul ni rab bsdus te/ /thub pas sngon bzhin bzhag par gyur/ /kye ma bsam yas lha rdzas 'di / /rnal 'byor can gyi sna tshogs gzugs/ /sangs rgyas lha yi yul yin te/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bdag gis mthong / /chos kyi sprin gyi ting 'dzin dang / /dga' dang mi g.yo de bzhin te/ /ring song mngon du gyur pa dang / /'od byed pa yi ma lus par/ /sgyu ma dpa' bar 'gro la sogs/ /gzi brjid can yang ma lus par/ /gzugs rnams kyi yang yul yin te/ /'og min thabs las byung ba'o / /de ni yid bzhin 'gyur sku yisari ri/ /dbang gi yon tan brgyad po rnams / /phra tshogs che ba'i yon tan dang / /'thob dang 'dod 'byor bsgrags pa dang / /bdag po dbang dang ldan pa dang / /ji ltar 'dod par rung ba'i rnams / /thob nas stug po'i dbus yul na/ /rnam par gnas shing rab tu rtse(ge / /sprul pa'i lha rdzas stug po nas/ /phyin pa dge ba de dag kyang / /lhun gyis grub pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /'phrul pa rnams ni 5rab tu 'byedakyi/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal sras su/ /thabs cig bzhugs par kun na snang / /de ltar sa 'di sna tshogs te/ /rang gi gzugs ldan rnams kyang 'dres/ /cha las phyir ldog de yi tshe/ /bya ba byas pas stug po'i gzhi/ /shes pas bcad cing mkhas pa'i rnams/ /thub pa dag gis stug po mthong / /gzhal med pad mo 'dra ba na / /me ltar rab tu 'bar ba yinan/ /thub pa rnal 'byor bde mos pa/ /rnal 'byor can dang lhan cig gnas/ /dpal be'u mtshan dang thams cad ldan//58—79

phra ba'i lus can rang gi 'od/ /de dag dbus su thub pa'i dbang / /khyod ni gnas par rab tu 'gyur/ /ltos shig lha yi zhi'od pan dang / /dru ma mi 'am ci yi bdag /gzhal med bye geb mang po yis/ /zla ba bzhin du rab tu 'bar/ /thub pa rnams dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /dga' ldan la sogs lha yi mchog /a ta sa /skuyi me tog 'dra/ /shes rab bzang 54)zhing mtshan mang ba/ /phreng ba cod pan thogs pa'i rnams/ /gzhal med mang pos gnas pa ste/ /lus ni rab tu 'bar ba dang / /kun mkhyen thams cad mngon gyur pa/ /thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang / /kun tu bzang po stobs chen te/ /zla ba 'dra ba'i gzhal med kyis / /stug po'i gang 5༄chen mtsho la gnas/ /rnam pa du mar thams cad nas/ /thub pa rnams kyis bstod pa ste/ /chags med tshangs pa'i khyu mchog dang / /grub dang dri za tshogs rnams dang / /mkhas dang nges par ldan pa yi/ /skyes bu'i tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdun du byas/ /rnal 'byor spyod pas khyad par du/ /gzims pa lta bur mthong ba ni/ /de dag le lo bral bas te/ /gnyid dang snyom 557sogs bsrabs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas lha yi rjes su 'brang / /mur 'dug kun gyis mthong gyur cing / /de bzhin lha dang tshangs la sogs / /'dzam gling pa dang 'og min dang / /'phrul gyis sprul pas thub mthong ba/ /'gro bas sna tshogs kun gzugs su/ /sa la kun nas zhugs dzostepar te/ /cho 'phrul rnam pa mang po yis/ /mgon po shin tu rnam par mdzes /la la nyal zhing rab tu 'bar/ /de bzhin gzhan dag phan tshun 'chag /la la g.yen /spyo brel cing 97sgom/ /de bzhin gzhan yang mya ngan 'da'/ /la la mngal du 'jug pa dang / /skye dang 'byung dang dka' spyod dang / /byang chub 58—80

rnam par 'tshang rgya zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor hu)bar ro/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang sangs rgyas yul/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'jigs med pa/ /de dag kun gyis 'thob 'gyur te/ /thub pa shākya'i (geseng ge yis / /ji ltar brnyes bzhin grogs po rnams/ /rgyal sras 'jigs pa med pa yis / /'di dag kun la yid ches kyis/ /yid ches gyur na sangs rgyas sam/ /thar bar 'gyur ba the tsom med/ /'khor lo 'khor ba'i rgyal por 'gyur(5)/ /spobs can khams kyi bdag po dang / /tshangs la sogs pa'i gnas su yang / /gnas 'gyur 'khor gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /dri med zhing gi pad mo la/ /thub pa'i dbus su skye bar 'gyur/ /pad mo'i dbus su skye ba yang / /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i sras kyis 'thob/ /brtson pas bdud cingasalas rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bag (5chags 'dod pa'i rgyu las kyang / /'dod bdag bdag po pham byas shing / /theg pa gcig la rab tu 'jug /brtson 'grus ldan zhing zhi med pa'i/ /rigs kyang thub pa 6)rab tu ston/ /sras po yangs pa'i rigs gyur cing / /zhing dang zhing du bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid du smon sems na/ /sangs rgyas rigs ni rnam par dag /75rnam dag rigs can sras de ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis (shelung bstan te/ /myur du sangs rgyas ci 'dra ba/ /de bzhin thub pa 'tshang rgya'o/ /rnam sangs rgyas nas nyer 'tsho ba/ /tshangs la sogs dang rnal 'byor can/ /sa ltar rtag pa'i dus su yang / /lus can rnams 59)la nye bar gnas/ /thams cad sman gyi rnal 'byor can/ /ji ltar grong dang grong gnas pa/ /nad rnams rab tu sel ba ltar/ /rab tu mkhas pa de byed pa/ /rnam rtog med pa'i yid kyis te/ /bcad kyang g.yo zhing 'gul 1 chib med/ /'di 58—81

ni rnam par rig pa tsam/ /yid ni nang dang phyir 35yang spyod/ /bdag dang bdag gi med pa ste/ /nor bar 2rimathong zhing mi g.yo'o/ /yid kyi rnam shes yul can gyi/ /kun gzhi kun nas gnas pa ste/ /gcad (5)dang gcod par byed pa dang / /de nyid gcad bya cagacod pa'ang yin/ /lus can kun gyi kun gzhi ni / /las kyi bag chags rnams kyis yog / khar ba gnor bu nyi ma dag /ldan las me 'byung 6ji bzhin te/ /gtsub ma gtsub stan 'dus las min/ /mis kyang byas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin sems yid rnam shes dang / /dbang po don dang yid dang las/ /sems rnams rab tu skyer gyur pa/ /rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs ci 7bzhin no/ /smig rgyu nam mkha' sgyu ma dang / /rmi lam ma yin nor ba'ang min/ /sbal pa rus 2sbal spu dag dang / /ri bong rwa dang mnyam pa'ang min/ /me ni shing las skye bar 'gyur/ /glog ni de bzhin sprin las so/ /med 9la skyed pa su yang med/ /rdza 1 sogs rdza mkhan lta bu'o/ /ji ltar rtswa 31dang shing dag la/ /brten cing lhan cig sgyu nya 'byung ba/ /de bzhin mos la sogs pa kun/ /sems dang sems byung lhan cig gnas/ /sems kyi yul ni bsam du med/ /sdug na gnas pas legs par mthong / /lha rdzas sngon med lhan cig skyes/ /mya ngan 'das dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /so sor ma brtags 'gog pa ltar/ /dus gsum rnam par spangs pa ste/ /'od can rtag tu dag pa ni / /lus can kun gyi kun gzhi'o18/ /dang po tshes pa'i zla mdog ltar/ /bye ba'i zhing du snang ba ste/ /ri rab gnas shing 'khor ba yang / /dngos po 'jig pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin yid sems rnam par shes/ /sems can khams na 'khor mod kyi/ /de la 'phel zhing 'bri med de/ /rtag tu rang bzhin 'od snang 58—82

ba'o / /ji ltar zla ba skye 'bri bar/ /mi shes 'gro ba rnam rtog kyang kyemo/ /skye 'bri zla la yod pa min/ /gling dang gling du'ang rab tu snang / /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes la/ /gyis pa mi shes 'gro rnams kyang / /rtag tu skye brir rnam rtog ste/ /de ni zag med sangs rgyas so/ /kun gzhi 'di la ji ltar yang / /'byung bas tha dad mi 'gyur te/ /'jug pa'i rnam shes song gnas pa/ /bag chags kyis ni zla ba bzhin/ /chu klung dbus kyi shing lta bur/ /chu bo'i klung dang 'grogs mod kyi/ /tha dad mtshan du'ang rab tu grub/ /rgya mtsho chen por de bzhin 'gro//de ltar kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /rtag tu bag chags ldan 'gyur ba rmo/ /rnam par shes pa bdun po dang / /'grogs kyang 'dre ba med pa ste/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dang / /rnam par dag pa'i rgyu yang de/ /chos mthong 'phags pa rnams kyi yang / /de ni rnal 'byor mnyam bzhag pa/ /byol song mi dang lhar skyes dang / /sha za lto 'phye yi dwags 4nodang / /lha min dri za 'bar ba yisade /lam rgyud kun kyang de yi dbang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzhi thamadzes la'ang /de nyid rgyur ni gyur pa ste/ /de rtogs nas ni sangs rgyas dang / /rigs dang theg pa gzhan min 'gyur/ /thams cad lus la rtag tu gnas/ /spyod long 7yod la rnam par 'dug /dpal dang ldan la khyad par du/ /thams cad kun kyang rab tu gnas/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma la'ang / /'gro ba dog pa thams cad na/ /de ni kun tu gnas pa ste/ /lus can rnams kyi lus la rten/ /'bras bu'i bdag dang rgyu yi bdag /nang gi bdag kyang de nyid la/ /byis pa rnams kyis khor /zug brtag /de yi dbyings la thog ma med/ /gnas ngan len dang las kyis bskyed/ /bag chags thog 9ma med pas bsags/ /'tsho 51—83

zhing gso bar byed pa ni/ /rnam par shes pa bdun po ste/ /yid ni rtag tu rlung dang mnyam/ /g.yo zhing myur bar rab tu 'jug /lus can rnams kyi lus gnas shing / /khams kyi gong la gnas pa'o/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod ①pa ni/ /dbang po rnams la khyab par gnas/ /rnam shes bdun dang lhan cig tu/ /dba' rlabs bzhin du rgyu ba ste/ /rdul phran dus dang gtso bo dang / /de bzhin skyes bu dbang bcas su/ /kun gzhi gcig pu dge ba de/ /rtog pa can gyis ther zug brtag /rtag tu sna tshogs rnam pa'i gzugs/ /g.yo zhing myur 'byung byed pa ste/ /kun gzhi (nas rnams thams cad du/ /phyi nang bcas par gnas pa yin/ /de ni sa yi rgyu yin par/ /rgyu can rnams kyis brtag pa ste(nye/ /de yi 'gro ba shin tu phra/ /rtog pa can rnams myos par byed/ /bdag don dbang po yid myos 4pa'i/ /yang dag ma mthong myos par 'gyur/ /sngon gyi las kyis bskyod 55pa yi/ /rnam par shes pa srid pa'i rgyu/ /sna tshogs gzugs can 'gro ba dang / /mi rnams kyi yang rgyu yin no/ /'jigs med rgyal ba'i sras rnams la / /rdo rje'i 6snying pos yang smras pa/ /kun gzhi dang lugs dge ba ni/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis mthong thos te/ /kun gzhi'i mchog tu dge ba ni/ /thams cad lus la zhen pa ste/ /sum cu stim gnyis mtshan ldan zhing / /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal ba 'khor lo 'khor bar yang sa rnams la lar 'gro bas mthong / /ji ltar zla ba skar tshogs dang / /lhan cig mkha' la gnas pa ltar/ /rnam shes rnams dang kun gzhi yang / /de bzhin lhan cig lus la gnas/ /ji ltar dbang gis sgyur ( )ba'i lha/ /lha yi bu mos mdun bdar cing / /rin chen dbus na rnam mdzes pa/ /de bzhin kun gzhi 50wa 84

sa rnams la/ /ji ltar chu dbang chu yi lha/ /chu klung rgya mtsho mching rnams la/ /ji bzhin skye ldan sa yang ste/ /de bzhin sems ni rnam par mdzes/ /ji ltar gzhal med gnas pa'i nyi6)/ /ri rab logs na rnam par mdzes/ /lha rnams kyis ni phyag kyang bya/ /de bzhin kun gzhi sangs rgyas sar/ /sa bcu dag la lhan cig tu/ /spyad pa spyod pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /theg pa chen pos phyung ba ste/ /lus la gnas pa rnam par mdzes/ /rjod ②pa'i zhal gyis rtag par yang / /rgyal ba rnams ni kun nas bstodage/ /nyan thos rnams dang rang rgyal dang / /rgyal ba'i sras rnams khyad par du/ /sa dang sa la rnam dag pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras zhesalgemangon bsgrags dang / /rgyal ba dag dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /de dag kun gzhila'adi la brjod/ /lung ston lung bstan 'gyur ba yi/ /rgyal sras rgyal ba de bzhin te/ /kun gzhi dri med bsod nams kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /'di lta bu yi (7kun gzhi'i 9)yul/ /stug na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /thub brtson rnal 'byor spyod pa yis/ /rab tu mthong zhing larnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas dag dang rang sangs rgyas/ /nyan thos rnams dang mur 'dug gzhan/ /de nyid rtogs nas mthong ba ni/ /rnal 'byor 'jigs med rnal 'byor ro/ /rnam par shes pa'i spyod yul gang / /'di ltar snang ba ci yang rung / /rnam par shes par gyur pa ste/ /rdza la sogs pa sa ma yin/ /'di ltar nor pa gang snang ba/ /sna tshogs rdza grags ci yang rung / /de ni kun gzhi 6)gyur pa ste/ /snang ba nor pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /kun gzhi chu klung de bzhin du/ /sna tshogs snang mngon 'gro bas mthong / /bag chags rnams kyis bsgos pa'i sems/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rab tu 'khor/ /dngos po sgyu 'dra 58—85

ma yin te/ /skra 1yi tshogs dang smig rgyu min/ /skyes dang ma skyes ma yin te/ /stong dang mi stong rnam par spangs/ /dngos su gcig med mi 'gyur te/ /ring dang thung la sogs pa bzhin/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin skyes pa ni/ /gang na ci yang yod pa min/ /de ni rig tshonasngags sgyu ma ste/ /skyes bu rnams la rab tu snang / /smig rgyu skra ri la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /gnyis las 4nye bar mngon pa ste/ /gcig med par ni gnyis po yang / /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /sgyu la sogs pa rnam brtags pa/ /'di ni rnam shes gyur pa'o/ /sgyu med sgyu zhes bya ba yi/ /dngos po gang dang gang yang med/ /ci 'ang rung ste gang yod pa/ /sgyu mas byas pa'ang 5yod pa yin/ /myos par byed pa 6'jig rten na/ /sems la dbang med rnams la yod/ /sgyu ma dag sam gyo mo dag /sna tshogs sgyu mas ma byas te/ /g.yo ba gang dag ci yang rung / /de ni snang min sus mi mthong / /'di la rnam rtog g.yo ba ni/ /khab long 7dag la lcags bzhin te/ /sems can med la mi rtag 8pa'i/ /shel sgong nor bu ji bzhin no/ /kun gzhi kun nas sna tshogs pa/ /byed pa bzhin du snang ba ste/ /skye zhing 'chi bar 'gyur mod kyi/ /'khor ba po ni gang yang med/ /rmi lam 'dra bar skye shi dag /rab tu mthong na rnam par 'grol / /thub pa gang tshe gyur pa na/ /grol ba zhes ni brjod pa ste/ /rigs dang gzhung gis bstan 9pa ni/ /sangs rgyas khyu mchog de yin no/ /thams cad chos la me long bzhin/ /srang 1 yin de bzhin tshad ma ste/ /dngos po kun la sgron ma bzhin/ /khab long 11ba yi rdo ltar gnas/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi mtshan nyid de/ /'jig pa rnams kyang rnam par bzlog /bsam gtan pa yi bsam gtan mchog /rnam par byang ba'i rgyu yin no/ /kun nas nyon mongs zad par 58—86

byed / /lam yang rnam par sbyong ba'o/ /dam pa'i don gyi spyod yul te/ /'gyur ba rab tu ston 17pa'o/ /'phags pa rgyan stug po las le'u bdun no ri // //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying pos phyogs bcur bltas te/ gtsug gi rin po che'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang / dbang byed kyi gnas dang / nor bu rin po che'i snying po'i pho brang na gnas pa'i rgyal ba'i /sras rnams la'ang snang bar byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'god pa ston 4pa la smras pa/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'god 5pa ston pa kha ba yod pa'i ngos la ri dgas thams cad gsod pa zhes bya ba'i ri dgas kyi rigs shig yod de/de ni gcom sgyu 6brgya stong gis ri dgas mang po nye bar brid cing thabs la bab pa'i ri dgas rnams bsad cing za'o/ /ri dgas drus ma phru gu dang bcas pa mthong na'ang phru gu'i skad du 'bod do/ /ri dgas rwa can mthong na'ang rwa de dang 'dra bar bsgyur te gan du 'gro'o/ /de nas de dag de la bag rton pa dang /des de dag bag rton par rig nas bsad cing bsad cing za'o/ /rwa mthong na'ang rwa'i gzugs su bstan te/ de dag bag phab nas ji ltar 'dod par bsad cing bsad cing za ste/ ji ltar ri dgas zhe 7gtum pa'i ngang tshul can de rnam pa sna tshogs kyis ri dgas gsod pa de bzhin du kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'ang phas kyi rgol ba mur 'dug bdag tu smra ba la mngon par zhen pa/ bdag gi chos nyid kyi rnam par gnas pa/ 'dzin pa de dang de dag gis bcings pa de dang de dag la de lta de lta bu'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid kyis bdag tu smra ba 58—87

yongs su rtog cing rdul phra mo yan chad du rab tu shes par byed pa de dag la de'i bdag tu 'dzin pa nyid du gnas pa ni gzhan du rnam par shes pa tsam du mi gnas pa'i bar du ste/ bdag yongs su rtogs par byed pa rnams kyis ni yid dang dbang po dang don du ldan pa las shes pa skye ba mthong gi/ bdag dang yid dang dbang po dang / don 'dus pa'i rgyu las ni ma yin no/ /dper na me tog dang gos su phrad na bsung 1)gi khyad par du 'gyur ( gyi/ ma phrad par ni bsung dmigs 5par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sems dang / sems las byung ba dang ca/ yid dang rnam par shes pa rnams ma gtogs par don de ma yin par gyur pa snod dang bdar lta bu'am/ me mar dang rdza lta bu'am/ smig long (snyedang i sha dzika lta bu gzhan ni gang yang med de/ rgyu dang rkyen las sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs rab tu 'byung zhing bdag med la phra ba dang / bskyed du mi rung ba dang / cha med pa dang / dag cing thog ma nas 'od snang ba dang /yul rnam par rig pa'i rnal 'byor can rnams kyi 'phags pa so so rang gis rig pa'i spyod yul ma gtogs par rtogs par byed pa rnams kyis mi dmigs so/ /'di nyid ni ri dgas kyi gcam 7༄zhe gtum po lta bur 'jig rten rnams la yod pa dang / med pa dang / gcig pa dang / mang po dang / thams cad dang /thams cad ma yin pa'i lta ba skyed par byed pa ste/ lus can rnam par rig pa tsam du khong du ma chud pa'i rnams bdag dang bdag gir smra ba la mngon par zhen par yang ltung bar byed do/ /mi shes pa'i phyir chos khong du chud par 'dod (3pa'i blos 'khor ba'i rgyud kyi 'khor lo la zhon zhing 'di dang pha bi nas rab tu rgyug ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 58—88

bral ba/ rang gi phyogs las ring ba bas kyang ches ring bar nyams pa'i blo can/'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad thob par mi nus pa/ theg pa gsum las 'ga' tsam la'ang mi 'jug pa'i rnam pa 'dzin pa las rnam par phyir ldog pa ma skyes kyi bar du 'phags pa'i bden pa mi mthong bas/ stug po'i dkyil 0)'khor gyi skal ba can rnams kyang stug po'am stug po'i sgra yang mi ( thos so/ /yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'god pa ston pa 'di ni rnal 'byor can rnams kyi lta ba yongs su sbyang ba ste/ 'di la khyod dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyis kyang brtson par gyis shig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing stug por 'jug pa'i gtam gyi tshul yang rnal 'byor can rnams la ston cig /rang gi rnam par rig pa'i yul zhes bya ba ste le'u brgyad do①// //khab long rdo la ji ltar lcags/ /yongs kyis kun tu rab 'khor ba/ /de bzhin phung po'i shing rta ste/ /stong zhing bag chags (gebyung ba 'khor/ /rtswa (snyedang 'jim pa shing smig dang / /thagashone)pa rnams su 'dus tshogs las/ /khyim du ji ltar snang gyur pa/ /de bzhin phung po'i gzugs 'di'o/ /lcags dang khab long ro langs la/ /sems can nye bar dmigs med kyang / /thams cad sems can lta bur g.yo/ /de bzhin phung po bdag med pa'o/ /rgyal sras phyag na rin chen gyis/ /gzugs (7)mang rgyal mchog la smras pa/ /mnyam bzhag ji rdo rje'i snying po la/ /rgyal po khyod kyis dri bar byos5)/ /rgyal sras 'jigs med mkhas pa'i rnams/ /kun gyis thos par 'gyur ba ni/ /brtag bral brtag par mi nus pa/ /brjod pas rnam par spangs pa ste/ /ming dang ming can rnam bral ba//58—89

'on kyang 'du ba de bzhin te/ /sna tshogs gyur pa'i sa 'di yi/ /rang bzhin ci dang cir gnas pa/ /de nas gzugs mang rgyal po yis/ /rdo rje snying po 'jigs med la/ /rjes su 'brel ba'i skabs dris pa1/ /dngos po don gzhan brtag pa ste/ /rdo rje'i dbang po'i dngos po gang / /la la rab tu brtag bya ba/ /ming dang 'du 2shes sogs pa'i yul/ /yod dam rdo rje snying pos smros/ /ming rnams sus byas ji lta bu/ /ming ni ci la rab tu gnas/ /mi mgon tshig ni thos pa dang / /rdo rje'i snying pos de la smras/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam ste / /'du shes tsam la rab tu gnas/ /brjod las tha dad gyur pa yi/ /brjod par bya ba yod pa min/ /phung po bzhi po ming yin te/ /gzugs kyang tsam zhes rnam par brtag /tsam la ming du btags dpa ni/ /skyes bu 'di zhes bya ba ste/ /tsam la mtshan ma zhes bya bar/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras dag gis gsungs / /mtshan ma med par ming du ni/ /de dag rnam par rtog mi nus/ /de bas mtshan ma rten byas shing / /ming du kun nas brtag pa yin/ /ji ltar lding dang lnga byid dang / /bar pa nga 4yang yod pa min/ /mtshan ma med par ci yang rung / /byis pas de la rnam 5mi brtag /de bzhin sa 'di thams cad kyang / /mtshan ma med par yod pa min/ /ci yang mtshan mar mi rtog pa/ /mtshan ma yod na rnam par brtag /rdza dang snam bu shing rta dag /gzugs yod pa la rnam par brjod/ /'jig rten 'di ni 'di tsam ste/ /gzugs tsam rnam pa gzhan mi 'gyur/ /tsam la ming du brtags 6pa ste/ /'di la yang dag ming yod min/ /ming med rnam par bral bar yang / /sa/ rnams thub pas mthong ba na / /rnam par rtog pa rab tu 'jug /rnam rtog med pa mi skye'o/ /tsher skye 58—90

med pa gzhan gyur pa/ /mi zad de la skye bar 'gyur/ /rgyu med phyir na ming med de/ /'du shes tsam la rnam par rtog /de bas rgyal pos rtag (1)par yang / /'du shes ma yin 'du shes sgoms/ /'di dag thams cad 'di tsam ste/ /thams cad las ni gzhan med do/ /tsam ni 5)gzugs su shes par bya/ /de bzhin lus dang gzugs dang dbyibs/ /cha lugs ring dang sku yangs te/ /mtshan ma dang ni rnam grangs gcig /'du shes ming dang rnam rtog dang / /brjod dang khyad par lhan cig ste/ /tsam dang mtshan ma 'du shes su/ /spyod par rab tu gdags pa ste/ /tsam la gnas de ming rnams kyang / /kun rdzob don du rnam par brtags/ /brjod pa med par dngos po ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /rnam shes rnams kyi 'byung ba yang / / rtog bya (5nyemed par yod pa min/ /rtog nga)bya ming dang tsam po ni/ /sa rnams thams cad de nyid de//dngos po gang la gang ming gis/ /brtag par bya ba de bzhin med/ /'di ni chos rnams chos nyid de/ /brtags na 5ciganas pa med pa'o/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam ste/ /'du shes can gyi dngos po med/ /de med pas 46)na ming med de/ /ming med pas na rnam mi brtag /rnam par mi rtog zhir 47 'gyur ba/ /bsreg pa tshig pa'i me bzhin te/ /khur tsas ji ltar khur bskur rinasib/ /de dang tha dad mtshan can te/ /de bzhin tsam ni ming gi khur/ /de dang tha dad mtshan nyid khyer/ /sems la tsam zhes rnam par brtags/ /ming gis tsam du sems tsam gyis/ /'di ni skyes bu sdong po zhes/ /ci yang rung ste ming tsam brtag /'byung ba rnams dang 'dus pa dang / /tsam yang gzugs la rnam par brtag /tsam po med par 'byung ba yi/ /tsam zhes bya ba mi dmigs te/ /bum pa'i ngos 58—91

la yon tan ltar/ /tsam la ming ni rnam par gnas/ /bum pa bum pa'i dngos po yis/ /rnam par dben zhing 0)ming dang bral/ /bum pa bum pa'i dngos por ram / /ming yang ming du gnas pa med/ /rnal 'byor can gyis gang gi tshe/ /ming tsam g.yo ba med pa dang / /rnam rtog gnyis dang 'brel pa yi/ /ming tsam yod med mthong ba na/ /ji ltar me ldan lcags rnams dang / /spra tshil dag kyang rgya skyegs kyang / /chu dang mnyam par khu bar 'gyur/ /'on kyang chu yi7yon tan med/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes pa/ /rnam shes bdun dang lhan cig tu / /rtag tu lus (kyesu 'jug par byed/ /rnam par shes pas yun du spangs/ /khab long rdo las rten byas shing / /lcags ni sems can bzhin 'khor yang / /de dag gnyis ka ༅byed pa med/ /sems can gson po bzhin du g.yo/ /sems ni bdun zhes bgrang ba yin/ /kun gzhi (sebargyad pa (7de bzhin no/ /bag chags srad bus brgyus (7)pas na/ /sems can bzhin g.yo sems can med/ /lus na (87kun tu rgyas par 'dug /'gro ba dog par 'khor ba ste/ /gcig las gcig gis mi shes pa/ /byed med lcags dang khab long bzhin/ /mgo bo du ma lce mang po/ /kha mang lag pa du ma dang / /lus kyang du mar rab bsgyur cing / /de bzhin gshegs la mchod byed pa/ /shin tu mang ba'i zhing gi rnams/ /tshad med stong du 'gro byas shing / /de dang der yang mgon po'i rnams/ /de dag kun la rtag mchod byed/ /ri rab ri dang mnyam pa yi/ /me tog na bza' char mang po/ /sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pas/ /de dag mchod pa rab tu byed/ /phreng ba phreng phyed 99cod pan dang / /rin chen brgyan pa sna tshogs kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen dang rgyal sras la/ /rtag par mchod pa rab tu byed/ /sprin 58—92

lta bu yi gzhal med khang / /sna tshogs mang po'i gzugs 'gyur ba/ /mtha' ma nam mkha'i mu dang mnyam/ /gzhan yang rdul phran rdul snyed kyi/ /sprul mang lha yi bu mo yis/ /rol mo sil snyan rab bsgrags 0)te/ /gzhal med dag la mngon gnas nas/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod pa (gyibyed/ /stobs dang mngon shes dbang thob cing / /dog pa'i sa nas ma nyams pa/ /chos kyi sprin las 'thon gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas sa la zhugs pa'i rnams/ /sgyu ma dpa' bar 'gro la sogs/ /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag ste/ /gzungs la mkhas par gyur pa'i rnams/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod pa (5)byed/ /sangs rgyas yang dag brjod mos rnams/ /mtha' yas zhing du 'gro byas shing / /yang dag yon tan ldan pa dag /sangs rgyas yon tan rab tu brjod(ge/ /dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud bcom ste/ /rgyal ba dag dang thabs cig tu/ /rgyal sras so so rang rig pa'i/ /rtogs par bya ba'i ting 'dzin sgom/ /gnas gzhan gyur pa'i (snyeyon tan can/ chos la bdag med ston pa'i rnams/ /spros pa thams cad rgyun bcad cing / /dam pa'i don la rnam sgom pa/ /chos lnga rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / /rnam shes brgyad la'ang de bzhin te/ /mkhas pa byas par rtag gyur cing / /mnyam par bzhag56)rnams mchod par byed(pe/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul 'dra dang / /de bzhin chen po'i lus kyis kyang / /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod pa (7byed/ /sa rnams kun ka (9)bdag lus dang / /yungs kur 'brur yang rab 'dzud byed/ /rgya mtsho ba lang rjes su byed / /ba lang rjes kyang gang tu )chen mtshor/ /spu gcig rtse mor brtan g.yo ba'i / /'gro ba rab tu 'dzud byed kyang77/ /gnod par byed pa ma yin te/ /58—93

'gro ba dag na rnam par spyod/ /longs spyod can gyi skyid longs yul/ /nyi zla sa dang mnyam pa ste/ /'tshig med sa dang 'dra bar yang / /rnam pa kun gyis phan 'dogs shing / /me dang rlung dag 'dra ba ste/ /rtag tu chu dang sman 'dra ba/ /rin chen khams kyi 'byung khungs ltar/ /sems can kun kyang nye bar 'tsho/ /skyes pa med 1cing 'gags pa med/ /ma chad rtag pa'ang med pa ste/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /'gro med 'ong ba med pa'i rnams/ /rnam par brtags 2pa'i ming dag dang / /kun du brtags pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed pa/ /ming dang ming med rnam spangs dgaci tsho /sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam 'dra/ /dri za'i grong khyer dpe bzhin te/ /smig rgyu chu yi zla ba 'dra / /rang bzhin kun du brtags pa dag /glog dang sprin dang du ba dang / /mgal pa'i 'khor lo smig rgyu 'dra/ /'di tshul brtags pa'i chos rnams ni/ /rang bzhin kun du brtags pa ste/ /gang dang gang gi ming rnams kyis/ /chos rnams gang dang gang brjod pa/ /de ni de na yod pa min/ /kun tu brtags pa'i rang bzhin no/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam ste/ /'gro ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /brjod 4pa dang ni tha dad pa/ /brjod par bya ba gang yang med/ /'di ni sa yi rang bzhin te/ /kun tu brtags pa rab tu bstan/ /mig dang gzugs las brten 5byas shing / /gsum las yid de 'byung ba yin/ /rnga sgra me ni 'du 'phrod las/ /myu gu sa bon sa las rim/ /khang pa la sogs sna tshogs dang / /snam bu rdza la sogs pa dang / /lus can rnams dang chos rnams kyi / /'di ni rang bzhin gzhan dbang ngo / /don rnams dor ba med pa dang / /gang yang zag pa med pa'i chos/ /so so rang rig rgyud rnams dang / /chos la (58—94

bdag med nyid dag 1)ni/ /thams cad chos kyi grub pa ste/ /rang bzhin du ni de brtags so/ /rang bzhin gyis ni chos kyi rnams/ /tha dad mtshan du bsgrags pa ste/ /chos rnams thams cad 'dres par ni/ /rang bzhin med na rab tu 'gyur/ /gcig min rdzas rnams 'dus pa las/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos gcig min gzugs/ /rtogs par sla ba ma yin pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i ri dgas byas pa bzhin/ /de ltar dngos po thams cad kyang / /rnam par rtog pas rnam par brtags / /rtog napar mi rung mi gcig gzugs/ /kun tu brtags pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sna tshogs nor bu 'dra ba yi/ /ri dgas rdzas kyi rgyu tshogs nas/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos rnam 55)byas dang / /sems can kun gyi gzugs bzhin te/ /de ltar dngos po 'di dag kun/ /rnam par rtogs 4pas rnam par brtags/ /rang bzhin rtogs par dka' ba ste/ /kun tu brtags pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ji ltar nor bu sna tshogs gzugs/ /tshon dang phrad na rnam par mdzes de bzhin sa rnams kun ka (5ste/ /rtog pas rnam par brtags byas na/ /yon tan dngos su mi gnas te/ /sgyu ma rmi lam sprin dang 'dra/ /smig rgyu chu zla lta bu ste/ /kun tu brtags pa'i rang bzhin no/ /ji ltar dri za'i khang pa dag /khang pa ma yin khang par snang / /rgyu med par yang mi snang ste/ /de bzhin sa rnams sna tshogs nyid/ /nyi zla gzhal yas khang rnams dang / /tha mal ri dang rin chen ri / /du ba sprin gyi gnod pas ni/ / nams kyang nyes par 6mi 'gyur te/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka las/ /rtog pas rnam par brtag 7byas na/ /dngos nyid mi 'grub dngos rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin kun tu brtag 8pa'o/ /rgyu las dngos po mi 'byung ste/ /rgyu med las kyang ma yin no/ /rang bzhin zhes bya 58—95

rnam rtog ste/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par brtags/ /mtshan ma la ni ming rten te/ /gnyis la rnam par rtog pa gnas/ /yang dag shes dang de bzhin nyid/ /rnam par rtog pa zlog pa'o/ /sems ni mtshan ma 'dra ba ste/ /mtshan ma yid la gnas pa yin/ /yid la sems rnams lnga po ni/ /dba' rlabs bzhin du rab tu 'byung / /sems ni bag chags rgyu ba ste/ /bag chags rnams la thog ma med/ /thog ma med pa'i blo yi yul/ /yul ni sems kyi nor ba'o / /sems ni yul dang 'dra ba ste/ /sa rnams yul zhes bya ba yin/ /thams cad sa bon kun gzhi la/ /rnam par shes pa kun kyang gnas/ /rnam shes bdun po kun gzhi las/ /rab tu 'byung ngo phan tshun dang / /sems kyi rnams dang kun gzhi la/ /rtag med chad pa'ang med pa ste/ /sa rnams thams cad kun gzhi yin/ /bar lho)snang rnam par gnas pa ste/ /gsum po 'dus pa'i rkyen byung ba/ /bdag dang dbang po dag las byung / /lus can rnams kyi rnam shes ni/ /yul rnams rnyed nas 'byung ba ste/ /'di ni rtog 9kyepa can gyi tshul/ /rgyu dang las kyi rgyus byung ba/ /dbang po sa rnams thams cad dang / /tshangs la sogs pa phyi rol dang / /de dag lha min las kyang min/ /rdul phran gyis kyang sa ma byas/ /sa (tshon rnams lta bur kun gzhi nyid/ /lta ba'i yul du g.yo ba yin/ /rkyen rnams kun gzhi ri ma byas te/ /rkyen gyis kun gzhi byas pa min/ /'di dag la ni gsum 'dus med/ /rnam shes 'on kyang 'khor ba ste/ /shel 'dra zla ba bzhin du yang / /rnam shes rnams dang lhan cig rgyu/ /bag chags byung ba'i rnam shes dang / /kun gzhi rtag tu 'grogs pa ni/ /zla ba spyang kyis 551zin pa bzhin / /rnam shes rnams dang lhan cig rgyu/ /bag chags de las langs pa 58—96

yis / /rgyas par byed do yang dang yang / /rgyas pa gzhan yang rgyas byed de/ /de la'ang gzhan gyis yang dang yang / /de ltar rab tu 'jug pa'i sems/ /mthong nas sems de rnam par ldog /mi brtan yul la kun nas 'brel/ /khab long rdo la lcags bzhin te/ /kun gyi gzhi la sems yod pa/ /zag bcas zag pa med pa dag /bag chags dag gis bsgos pa'i rnams/ /'jug dang phyir ldog byed pa yin/ /ji ltar bsreg hu)las me bus shing / /gzhan du me yang rab tu bud/ /de dang gzhan du de bzhin bud/ /de dag nas kyang spo bzhin dang / /de ltar kun gzhi rnam shes dang / /gzhan yang de las byung ba rnams/ /chos la rab tu rgyu ba ni/ /gtogs dang zag pa med pa dag /mthong ba'i chos la gnas pa yi/ /yul dang yul can de yin te/ /'phags pa mthong ba'i chos can gyi/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang 'di dag yin/ /'phags pa de dag de ldan zhing / /sgom dang mthong dang〈geldan pas na/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid shes pa/ /zhing nas zhing du rab tu 'dong / /ji ltar shin tu bzang ba'i gser/ /gser gyi dbyings na mi snang ste/ /brtsal bas shin tu zhib btags nas/ /yongs su sbyangs na snang bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes pa/ /rnam par shes pa bdun dang bcas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis yongs sbyangs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu mthong / /ji ltar ma bsrubs zho la 5/nga / /de na mar yod mi snang ste/ / bsrub pa'i zhiratshul gyis mthong bas na/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de phyir bsrub/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /rnam shes bdun dang ldan pa yang / /rnam par bsrubs shing stug spyod pa'i/ /thub pa rnams kyis 54 mthong ba yin/ /ma rig pa ni sdug 45)ces bya/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes rnam grangs te/ /58—97

dkyil 'khor 'di la bslabs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor can rnams stug ༅por 'dong / /gzugs med gzugs yod nam mkha' dang nano/ /rnam shes 'du shes ma yod dag /rnal 'byor can gyis yul bsgoms sam/ /de dag stug po'i zhing du 'dong / /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od bzhin du/ /'jigs pa med pa'i rgyal ba'i sras / /rnal 'byor can gyi thub ston cing / /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lam gnas pa / /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur 4bas/ /de ni dbang bskur stug por song / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rjes su mthong / /gzhan du gyur nas stug por song / /stug na gnas shing sprul pa dang / /sprul pa'i sprul pa de dag gis/ /gang na gang chos su 'dod pa/ /de ni mkha' la 'dug cing ston sku/ /sngon med dus kyi gnas ngan len/ /bag chags rgyu yis bsags pa yi/ /kun gzhi rnam rtog 6byas pa yis/ /bcings pa kun tu rab tu 'byung / /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs rnams/ /rlung gis rab tu bskyod pa dag /rgyun mi 'chad par rab tu 'byung / /rnam shes de bzhin kun gzhi la/ /rnam shes de ni des byas pa'i / /bag chags rnams kyis rgyas par 'gyur/ /'byung zhing la la phyir ldog ste / chad med rtag pa med pa'o/ /rang sems khong du ma chud pas/ /yul la gzhol ba'i rnam shes rnams/ /rab tu zhugs kyang phyir ldog pa/ /'gro ba rang sems mthong ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gzhan du gyur pa'i sems/ /me dang bsreg pa ji bzhin te/ /kun gzhi yul ltar snang ba yang / /gzhan du gyur nas zag pa med/ /zag med 'gros su song ba dang / /'phags pa'i rigs su skye bar (7'gyur / /kun gzhi yul ltar snang ba ni/ /sa rnams khyab 8par byas shing gnas / /yid ni bdag la bdag ces te/ /ngar 9 sems rab tu 'jug pa 58—98

yin / /rnam shes kha dog khyad par dang / /kun du gcod pa rab tu byed/ /sems ni las rnams sogs tsho17pa ste/ /yid ni khong du chud par byed/ /rnam par shes pas rnam par rig /lnga pos snang ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /rab rib ldan pa myos pa yis/ /ji ltar skra tshogs mthong ba bzhin/ /gzugs la sogs la cigazugs med de/ /sems ni gzugs ltar gnas pa yin/ /nyi ma zla ba'i nor bu dag /yongs su dag pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /nyi zla'i zer gyis phog pa dang / /de dag rang gi yon tan 'byin/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge snying po/ /zag med legs dang ldan gyur te/ /gzhan du 'gyur na rab tu 'byin/ /'di ltar snang ba gang yang rung / /mtshan ma gzugs ri su snang ba'i rnams/ /bag chags yog pa'i kun gzhi ste/ /sa rnams kun na gzugs ltar gnas/ ji ltar 'o ma 4gyur pa dang / /yon tan zho dang dar bar snang / /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /rnam par gyur nas gzugs ltar gnas/ /ji ltar rab rib ldan pas skra/ /mig gi nyes pas rnam mthong ba/ /de bzhin bag chags nyes ldan pa'i/ /kun gzhi lus can rnams kyi cir ste/ /rtag tu mig gi nang song ba'i/ /gzugs kyi snang ba rinerab tu 'jug /'di dag snang ba ci yang rung / /smig rgyu chu yi dpe bzhin te/ /gzugs ni yod dang med kyis spangs/ /kun gzhi rjes su mthong ba'o/ /mig dang gzugs las rten byas shing / /de ni sgyu ma bzhin du 'byung / /rtag tu mig gi nang song ba/ /smig rgyu bzhin du rab tu g.yo/ /gzugs kyi yon tan ldan pa'i gzugs/ /kun gzhi 7gzugs ltar gnas pa ste/ /byis pa ji ltar brtags pa bzhin/ /gzugs ni gud na yod pa min/ /byed med sems pa'ang 58—99

med pa ste/ /dbu ba'i phung po bzhin du gnas/ /gnyid stilog ra ro dregs pa dang / /'gro 'dug rnam par rgyug pa yi/ / bya ba cig car byed pa ni/ /②lus can rnams kyi kun gzhi'o/ /ji ltar gdung bas bsar bus las/ /gyen du ldang ba'i smig rgyu rnams/ /dpyid po'i chu ltar rab tu g.yo/ /ri dgas rnams la slu bar byed/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /gzugs min lta ba'i spyod yul du/ /gzugs snang ji ltar rtog can gyis/ /brtags bzhin gzugs 'dra ma yin no/ /ji ltar khab long mthong ba dang / /lcags ni myur bar kun tu 'khor/ /'on kyang de la sems pa med/ /sems ldan bzhin du'ang rab tu snang / /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /sems med sems can ji bzhin du / /'gro dang 'ong bar g.yo ba ste/ /sa rnams 'bri bar rab tu byed/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i pedza ru ni/ /srog med par yang g.yo 'gul ⑤te/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes pa/ /lus la gnas shing g.yo bar gyur/ /glang po glang po'i gzugs brnyan dang / /ji ltar 'thab cing choms nas min/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes pa/ /'jug pa choms nas mi rgyu'o/ /ji ltar pad mo dri med pa/ /'dam gyi nang nas byung ba ni/ /mi dang lha dang btsun la 'os/ /lha yul gnas pa kun kyang 'dod/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /bag chags 'dam nas byung ba ni/ /rnam dag gzhan du gnas gyur pa/ /bdag nyid che rnams 'dod pa yin/ /ji ltar rin chen rnam par dag /ri brags (6rimi yis bcags brdungs kyang / /rgyal po'i cod pan du yang 'os/ /cod pan la yang gdags pa yin/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /bag chags rnams kyis bcagasasko7)brdungs pa/ /rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs yin te/ /sangs rgyas nyid du de 58—100

gzung ①ngo / /ji ltar chu gting rdo ba dag /nya lcibs dag gis yongs dkris pa / /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /bag chags dri ma can du byas/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i gzungs (gyesu yang / /dngos po gnyis kyis rab tu 'jug /ji ltar kha gnyis yod pa'i sbrul/ /gang du 'dod pa der 'gro ste/ /de bzhin tshikun gzhi rnam par shes/ /rim dang cig car rgyu ba yin/ /rtag tu sna tshogs gzugs lta bu/ /de la rtog pas rnam par brtag /rtog can rnam par myos 'gyur ba/ /bdag dang bdag dir rnam rtog cing / /yod dang med kyi rgyu sdod pa'i/ /sa rnams la yang rnam rtog ste/ /'gyur ba'i yongs su gyur pa dang / /kun gzhi zab pa nyid dag kyangasnye/ /blo chung rnams kyis mi rigs 5pas / /sgyu ma'i ri dgas bzhin du 'khor/ /rang bzhin gcig min shes par dka' / /lus can kun la 'dra ba ste/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /rtag tu sgyu ma'i ri dgas 'dra/ /sems can gcig min shes par dka'/ /yod dang med par rnam par brtagasayi/ /rdul dang gtso bo skyes bu dang / /mi (3gsal tshangs pa'ang de yin te/ /rtog pas 'khrul pa'i rtog can rnams/ /kun gzhi la ni rtag tu rtog /sa rnams lta bur gnas pa la/ /sna tshogs sar yang de bzhin rtog /sa la gang gis rtog (shegyur pa'i/ /yid ni kun nas rtog ces bya/ /ji ltar ri mo mtho dman dzi)dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sprin gyi gzugs/ /'ja' dang ri dgas sred byed dang / /sprin sgra 'brug kyang ji bzhin te/ /rab rib can gyi phreng ba dang / /bzang mo'i gdong yang de bzhin du/ /rmi lam dag na nyi rnam sna tshogs/ /dri za'i khang pa gnas rten dang / /ro langs chu yi shing rnams dang / /brag carwastesprin dang du ba dang / /me long mig la gzugs brnyan dang / /50wa 101

chu la chu yi 35zla ba dang / /rnam rtog 'di dang mang por yang / /'gro ba rnams ni kun gzhi rtog /gang tshe kun gzhi 'di 'dra bar/ /rnam pa (0sna tshogs kun mthong ste/ /'gro ba rang sems mthong ba dang / /de'i tshe sems ni phyir ldog go /chos rnams thams cad kun gyi gzhi/ /bag chags snyems la sa sogs pa dang / /rtog pas rnyog pa can du byas/ /gzhan du gyur nas zag pa med/ /zag med ngang lalugs rab thob nas/ /de dag rtag cing brtan par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' mya ngan 'das dang mnyam/ /'gog dang 'dra ba de bzhin te/ /mnyam gzhag sku sems dang ldan pa la/ /mi zag chos rnams skye bar 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul bsam gtan rnam thar 'dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang stobs rnams dang / /thabs 7dang stobs dang mngon shes dganari /'bri med mi zad de bzhin te/ /nam mkha' zad kyi mthar snyegs 9shing / /dbyings blo rnam shes rtag pa dang / /mthar phyin bcu yi gnas ldan zhing / /yid bzhin shin tu brtan pa'i lus/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /gzhan du gyur nas rab tu 'thob/ /'jig pa mya ngan 'da' ma yin/ /sems can yod min skye ba med/ /'bri med gang ba med par yang / /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'gro ba 1 bshad/ /zhing gzhan rnams dang zhing 'di yi/ /chos nyid gcig tu zad pa ste/ /skyes par gyur tam ma skyes kyang / /chos rnams chos nyid de bzhin gnas/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa grol 1 ba la/ /rtag med chad pa med pa ste/ /sems can khams rnams zhig gyur na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mi snang ngo / /ma byon pa yi rgyal ba dang / /'das dang da ltar byung ba dag /mnyam pa ma yin 'thun 12pa min/ /shes bya zad nas de dag 'byung / /bdud rnams tshar bcad log pa ste/ /brjod dang 58—102

bcas dang brjod med kyang / /de ste sems can 'jig na ni/ /sdug bsngal sbubs nyu7las mi 'grol lo/ /lcags kyi gar bu bsregs pa las/ /me las byung ste bsil gyur cing / /lcags ni rtag par 'dug pa bzhin/ /de ltar rnal 'byor can dag 'khod/ /phung po'i khyim dang nges byung ba'i/ /bag chags rnams kyang gyur 2pa dang / /thub pa rnal 'byor brtson pa'i rnams/ /de dag rtag cing grol ba yin/ /rnam shes rnams ni dba' rlabs bzhin/ /kun gzhi mtsho las 'byung ba ste/ /chos lnga'i rang bzhin rnam shes kyis/ /rab tu bskyod cing shin tu rgyu/ /gnas ngan len gyi /spros pa yis/ /bcom pa gnas med don gyi gzugs/ /lta ba'i yul du rnam par g.yo/ /de ltar shes nas phyir los ste / /gzhan gyur mi bzad rtag pa'i rnams/ /mgon po dag ni stug por 'dong / /stug na gnas pa zla ba bzhin/ /rtag tu gzugs brnyan rnam par mdzes / /phung po stug pa kun gzhi ste/ /yid ni de la nye phan no/ /rnam par shes pa rtogs par byed/ /gzugs dang las la sogs pa'i rgyu/ /rnam shes lnga yi tshogs rnams ni/ /dbang por bcas shing yul gzhol bas/ /sna tshogs yid 4la 'dzin par byed/ /kun gzhi yu la can ma yin no/ /tshe ni kun gzhi rnam shes te / /yid ni drod du rab tu gnas/ /yid kyi rnam shes de na ste/ /lhag ma dbang po lngar yang gnas/ /sems dang yid dang rnam par shes/ /phung po'i dbus na rnam 5par gnas/ /bag chags las dang 'brel ba'i rnams/ / sngon cad 46 byas pa rnams kyis 'byung / /'dod chags srid las byung ba yi/ /las kyis bya ba byed pa ste/ /sngon 7chad de dag las byas pas/ /rgyun du las rnams 'byung ba yin/ /lus las lus ni gzhan la 'gro/ /'pho ba srin bu pad pa 858—103

bzhin / /sems dang sems byung bcas pa'i rnams/ /rgyun chags par ni shin tu 'dong / /yang zhing phung po'i tshogs rnams dang / /rnam shes srid pa dog par yang / /tshogs shing rab tu 'byung ba ni/ /las rnams shin tu 'byung ba'i phyir / /tshe dang drod dang rnam shes 'dis/ /gang tshe lus ni bor gyur pa/ /de tshe lus ni dor ba ste/ /shing bzhin tshor ba med pa'o/ /sems ni kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /ngar sems bdag nyid yid yin no/ /gang zhig yul la 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni rnam par shes zhes hu)bya/ /sems ni las rnams sogs (0pa ste/ /yid ni khong du chud gepar byed/ /rnam par shes pas rnam par rig /lnga pos snang ba rtogs par byed// //'phags pa rgyan pusastug po/ bam po bzhi pa ste tha ma(snye/ lus ni sems kyis bzung ba yin/ /yid ni lam rgyud 'dod pa ste/ /rnam par shes pas rnam par rig /snang ba gcod pa lnga po'o6)/ /rgyu la dmigs shing rnam shes rnams/ /skye ste gzhan ni ⑦de rjes 'brang / /yid la dmigs shing gzhan dag kyang / /mthar chags su ni rab tu 'byung / /yid rnyed nas kyang gzhan dag ni/ /dbang gi yon tan rnams kyis byas/ /dbang ni lnga dang lhan cig tu/ /rnam (shepar shes pa rab tu byed/ /'du byed rgyu dang lhan cig tu/ /ro langs 'gro dang 'dra ba ste/ /smig rgyu dag ni 997gzugs dang pho mnyam/ /log pa ma yin bden pa min1rta / /'di ni bdag med stong pa ste/ /srid 3)pas kun du drangs pa hurteyin/ /'byung rnams lhan cig 'byung ba dag /thams cad dus yidam1rilhan cig ste/ /sems byung yid ces bya ba dang / /lhan cig rnam par shes pa 'byung / /rnam shes lnga po de dag dang / /yid kyi rnam shes ldan pa ni/ /gnas ngan len dang 58—104
